actions.description: A light drake can breathe a 30-foot line of brilliant white light. Each creature in that line must make a DC 13 Dexterity saving throw. On a failure, a creature takes 5 (2d4) radiant damage and is blinded for 1 minute. On a success, a creature takes half the damage and isn't blinded. A blinded creature can make a DC 13 Constitution saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.

monster:tob3:light-eater.speed: 10 ft., Climb 5 ft., Fly 40 ft., Swim 5 ft.

traits.name: False Appearance
traits.description: While motionless indistinguishable from normal rock.

traits.name: Light Absorption
traits.description: When it starts its turn within 5 ft. of a source of light light is reduced while eater remains within 100' of light source. Bright light becomes dim and dim becomes darkness. If eater reduces light source’s light to darkness eater sheds multicolored bright light in 20' radius and dim light for additional 20' for 1 hr and light source is extinguished if it is nonmagical flame or dispelled if it was created by 2nd level or lower spell.

traits.name: Light Sense
traits.description: Can pinpoint location of any light source within 100' of it and sense general direction of any within 1 mile.

reactions.name: Emergency Flare
reactions.description: When it takes damage can emit brilliant flash of light. Each creature within 30': blinded 1 min (DC 12 Con negates). Blinded creature can re-save at end of each of its turns success ends effect on itself.

traits.name: Innate Spellcasting
traits.description:
the likho's innate spellcasting ability is Charisma (spell save DC 16). It can innately cast the following spells, requiring no material components:

at will: message

3/day each: crown of madness, mirror image, ray of enfeeblement

1/day: bestow curse

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.description: The likho has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

traits.name: Pounce
traits.description: If the likho moves at least 20 feet straight toward a creature and then hits it with a claw attack on the same turn, that target must succeed on a DC 14 Strength saving throw or be knocked prone. If the target is prone, the likho can use a bonus action to make two additional claw attacks against it.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The likho makes two claw attacks.

actions.name: Claw
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 10 (2d6 + 3) slashing damage.

actions.name: Disruptive Gaze
actions.description: As a bonus action, the likho directs its gaze at any single creature it can see and afflicts it with a temporary bout of bad luck. The targeted creature has disadvantage on attack rolls, saving throws, and skill checks until the end of its next turn.

traits.name: Limited Telepathy
traits.description: The likho can magically transmit simple messages and images to any creature within 120 feet of it that can understand a language. This form of telepathy doesn’t allow the receiving creature to telepathically respond.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.description: The likho has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

traits.name: Pounce
traits.description: If the likho moves at least 20 feet straight toward a creature and then hits it with a Claw attack on the same turn, that target must succeed on a DC 15 Strength saving throw or be knocked prone. If the target is prone, the likho can make one Claw attack against it as a bonus action.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The likho can use its Disruptive Gaze. It then makes four Claw attacks.

actions.name: Claw
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 8 (1d8 + 4) slashing damage.

actions.name: Disruptive Gaze
actions.description: One creature the likho can see within 60 feet of it must succeed on a DC 15 Charisma saving throw or have disadvantage on attack rolls, ability checks, and saving throws until the end of its next turn.

monster:tob2:liminal-drake.damageResistances: acid, fire, lightning, radiant, thunder; bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing from nonmagical attacks
monster:tob2:liminal-drake.conditionImmunities: exhaustion, frightened, grappled, paralyzed, petrified, poisoned, prone, restrained

traits.name: Incorporeal Movement
traits.description: The drake can move through other creatures and objects as if they were difficult terrain. It takes 5 (1d10) force damage if it ends its turn inside an object.

traits.name: Nauseating Luminance
traits.description:
When a creature that can see the drake starts its turn within 60 feet of the drake, the drake can force it to make a DC 16 Constitution saving throw if the drake isn’t incapacitated and can see the creature. On a failed save, the creature is incapacitated until the start of its next turn.

Unless surprised, a creature can avert its eyes to avoid the saving throw at the start of its turn. If it does so, it can’t see the drake until the start of its next turn, when it can avert its eyes again. If the creature looks at the drake in the meantime, it must immediately make the save.

traits.name: Void Dweller
traits.description: When traveling through the void between stars, the liminal drake magically glides on solar winds, making the immense journey in an impossibly short time.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The liminal drake makes three attacks: one with its bite and two with its claws.

actions.name: Bite
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +12 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. Hit: 14 (2d10 + 3) piercing damage plus 18 (4d8) cold damage.

actions.name: Claw
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +12 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. Hit: 10 (2d6 + 3) slashing damage plus 9 (2d8) cold damage.

actions.name: Stellar Breath
actions.description: The drake exhales star fire in a 30-foot cone. Each creature in that area must make a DC 17 Dexterity saving throw, taking 18 (4d8) fire damage and 18 (4d8) radiant damage on a failed save, and half as much damage on a successful one.

actions.name: Warp Space
actions.description: The liminal drake can fold in on itself to travel to a different plane. This works like the plane shift spell, except the drake can only affect itself, not other creatures, and it can't use the effect to banish an unwilling creature to another plane.

monster:tob:lindwurm.senses: darkvision 60 ft., tremorsense 120 ft., passive Perception 14

traits.name: Lindwurm Fever
traits.description: A creature infected with this disease by a lindwurm's bite gains one level of exhaustion an hour after being infected. The creature must make a DC 14 Constitution saving throw after each long rest. On a failure, the creature gains one level of exhaustion and recovers no hit dice from the long rest. On a success, the creature recovers from one level of exhaustion and regains hit dice normally. If the infected creature reduces itself to zero exhaustion by making successful saving throws, the disease is cured.

traits.name: Skittering Skater
traits.description: Lindwurms suffer no penalties from difficult terrain on ice and are immune to the effects of the grease spell.

traits.name: Snake Belly
traits.description: When lying with its sensitive stomach on the ice, a lindwurm can sense approaching creatures by the vibrations they cause, granting them tremorsense.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The lindwurm makes one bite attack, one claw attack, and one constrict attack.

actions.name: Bite
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 13 (2d8 + 4) piercing damage, and the target must succeed on a DC 14 Constitution saving throw or contract lindwurm fever.

actions.name: Claws
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 17 (3d8 + 4) slashing damage.

actions.name: Constrict
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 13 (2d8 + 4) bludgeoning damage, and the target is grappled (escape DC 14). Until this grapple ends, the target is restrained, and the lindwurm can constrict only this target.

monster:tob-2023:lindwurm.senses: darkvision 60 ft., tremorsense 120 ft., passive Perception 14

traits.name: Ice Walk
traits.description: The lindwurm can move across icy surfaces without needing to make an ability check. Additionally, difficult terrain composed of ice or snow doesn’t cost it extra movement.

traits.name: Sure-Footed Skater
traits.description: While the lindwurm is on snow or ice, it has advantage on Strength and Dexterity saving throws made against effects that would knock it prone.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The lindwurm makes one Bite attack and two Claw attacks. It can replace its Bite attack with one Constrict attack.

actions.name: Bite
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +8 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 16 (2d10 + 5) piercing damage. If the target is a creature, it must succeed on a DC 15 Constitution saving throw or contract a disease and be poisoned until the disease is cured. At the end of each long rest, the diseased creature must repeat the saving throw. On a failure, the creature suffers one level of exhaustion and doesn't regain expended Hit Dice from the rest. On a success, the creature's exhaustion level decreases by one, and it regains expended Hit Dice as normal from the rest. If a successful saving throw reduces the diseased creature's level of exhaustion below 1, the creature recovers from the disease, ending it.

actions.name: Claw
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +8 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 12 (2d6 + 5) slashing damage.

actions.name: Constrict
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +8 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 14 (2d8 + 5) bludgeoning damage, and the target is grappled (escape DC 15). Until this grapple ends, the target is restrained, and the lindwurm can't Constrict another target.

traits.name: Keen Smell
traits.description: The lion has advantage on Perception checks that rely on smell.

traits.name: Long Jump
traits.description: The lion can long jump up to 25 feet.

traits.name: Pack Tactics
traits.description: The lion has advantage on attack rolls against a creature if at least one of the lions allies is within 5 feet of the creature and not incapacitated.

actions.name: Claws
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 7 (1d8+3) slashing damage. If the lion moves at least 20 feet straight towards the target before the attack  the target makes a DC 13 Strength saving throw  falling prone on a failure.

actions.name: Bite
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 8 (1d10+3) piercing damage.

bonusActions.name: Opportune Bite
bonusActions.description: The lion makes a bite attack against a prone creature.

traits.name: Heightened Smell
traits.description: The lion's Perception is 18 when perceiving by smell.

traits.name: Pack Tactics
traits.description: The lion has advantage on attack rolls against a creature if at least one of the lion's allies is within 5 feet of the creature and the ally isn't incapacitated.

traits.name: Pounce
traits.description: If the lion moves at least 20 feet straight toward a creature and then hits it with a Claws attack on the same turn, that target must succeed on a DC 13 STR save or be knocked prone. If the target is prone, the lion can make one Bite attack against it as a bonus action.

traits.name: Running Leap
traits.description: With a 10-foot running start, the lion can long jump up to 25 feet.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The lion makes one Bite attack and one Claws attack.

actions.name: Bite
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. Hit: 7 (1d8+3) piercing damage.

actions.name: Claws
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 6 (1d6+3) slashing damage.

bonusActions.name: Rattling Roar
bonusActions.description: The lion releases a bone-shaking roar in a 15-foot cone. Each creature in the area must succeed on a DC 13 CON save or have disadvantage on attack rolls until the end of its next turn.

monster:tob:liosalfar.senses: blindsight 120 ft., truesight 60 ft., passive Perception 17
monster:tob:liosalfar.damageResistances: acid, cold, fire, lightning, thunder; bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing from nonmagical attacks
monster:tob:liosalfar.conditionImmunities: blinded, charmed, exhaustion (see Lightform special ability), grappled, paralyzed, petrified, poisoned, prone, restrained, unconscious

traits.name: Alien Mentality
traits.description: A liosalfar's exotic consciousness renders it immune to psychic effects, and any attempt to read their thoughts leaves the reader confused for 1 round.

traits.name: Darkness Vulnerability
traits.description: Magical darkness is harmful to a liosalfar: They take 2d10 necrotic damage, or half damage with a successful DC 14 Constitution saving throw, each time they start their turn inside magical darkness. Natural darkness is unpleasant to them but not harmful.

traits.name: Incorporeal Movement
traits.description: The liosalfar can move through other creatures and objects as difficult terrain. It takes 5 (1d10) force damage if it ends its turn inside an object.

traits.name: Innate Spellcasting
traits.description:
the liosalfar's innate spellcasting ability is Intelligence (spell save DC 15, +7 to hit with spell attacks). It can innately cast the following spells, requiring no material components:

at Will: augury, color spray, dancing lights, detect magic, flare, light, silent image, spare the dying

2/day each: alter self, blur, divination, hypnotic pattern, prismatic spray, scorching ray

1/day each: hallucinatory terrain, plane shift, sunbeam

traits.name: Lightform
traits.description: Liosalfar are composed entirely of light. They are incorporeal and not subject to ability damage, polymorph, petrification, or attacks that alter their form.

traits.name: Prismatic Glow
traits.description: Liosalfar shed rainbow illumination equal to a daylight spell. They cannot extinguish this glow without perishing but can reduce it to the level of torchlight at will. Even when using alter self they have a faint, diffused glow that's visible in dim light or darkness.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The liosalfar makes two Disrupting Touch attacks.

actions.name: Disrupting Touch
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +10 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 26 (4d12) radiant damage, and the target must succeed on a DC 15 Wisdom saving throw or become stunned for 1 round.

monster:tob-2023:liosalfar.damageResistances: bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing from nonmagical attacks
monster:tob-2023:liosalfar.conditionImmunities: blinded, charmed, exhaustion, grappled, paralyzed, petrified, poisoned, prone, restrained, unconscious

traits.name: Darkness Hypersensitivity
traits.description: The liosalfar takes 15 necrotic damage when it starts its turn in magical darkness. While in magical darkness, it has disadvantage on attack rolls and ability checks.

traits.name: Elemental Nature
traits.description: The liosalfar doesn’t require air, food, drink, or sleep.

traits.name: Inscrutable
traits.description: The liosalfar is immune to any effect that would sense its emotions or read its thoughts, as well as any divination spell that it refuses. Wisdom (Insight) checks made to ascertain the liosalfar’s intentions or sincerity have disadvantage.

traits.name: Light Form
traits.description: The liosalfar can enter a hostile creature’s space and stop there. It can move through a space as narrow as 1 inch wide without squeezing. In addition, it sheds bright light in a 10- to 30-foot radius and dim light for an additional number of feet equal to the chosen radius. The liosalfar can alter the radius as a bonus action.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The liosalfar makes two Radiant Touch or Ray of Light attacks. If both Radiant Touch attacks hit one creature, the target must succeed on a DC 16 Constitution saving throw or be stunned until the end of its next turn.

actions.name: Radiant Touch
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +11 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 29 (4d10 + 7) radiant damage.

actions.name: Ray of Light
actions.description: Ranged Spell Attack: +8 to hit, range 60 ft., one target. Hit: 31 (6d8 + 4) radiant damage, and the target must succeed on a DC 16 Constitution saving throw or be blinded until the end of its next turn.

actions.name: Mesmerizing Radiance
actions.description: The liosalfar causes the light radiating from its body to shift color and pattern in a spellbinding display. Each creature within 60 feet of the liosalfar and that can see it must succeed on a DC 16 Wisdom saving throw or be charmed until the display ends. The liosalfar must take a bonus action on its subsequent turns to continue the display. It can stop the display at any time, and the display ends if the liosalfar is incapacitated. While charmed by the liosalfar's display, a creature is also incapacitated, and its speed is reduced to 0, as it is transfixed by the display. The effect ends for a charmed creature if it takes any damage or if someone uses an action to shake the creature out of its stupor.

monster:bfrd:living-colossus.languages: any languages the animating spirit knew in life

traits.name: Construct Nature
traits.description: The living colossus doesn't require air, food, drink, or sleep.

traits.name: Construct Resilience
traits.description: The living colossus is immune to poison and psychic damage, and it is immune to exhaustion and the charmed, frightened, paralyzed, petrified, and poisoned conditions.

traits.name: False Appearance
traits.description: While the living colossus remains motionless, it is indistinguishable from a normal statue or monument of the individual it represents.

traits.name: Immutable Form
traits.description: The living colossus is immune to any spell or effect that would alter its form.

traits.name: Siege Monster
traits.description: The living colossus deals double damage to objects and structures.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The living colossus makes three Slam attacks, or it makes four Spirit Blast attacks.

actions.name: Slam
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +15 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 32 (4d10+10) bludgeoning damage.

actions.name: Spirit Blast
actions.description: Ranged Spell Attack: +11 to hit, range 120 ft., one target. Hit: 24 (4d8+6) psychic damage.

actions.name: Thunderous Clap
actions.description: The living colossus slams its hands together, creating a thunderous wave in a 30-foot cone. Each creature in that area must make a DC 18 CON save, taking 59 (17d6) thunder damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

bonusActions.name: Quake
bonusActions.description: The living colossus strikes the ground with its foot. Each creature within 30 feet of the living colossus must succeed on a DC 18 STR save or be knocked prone and have the air knocked from its lungs, if it is a breathing creature, until the start of the living colossus's next turn. A creature with the air knocked from its lungs can't speak or cast spells with verbal components. If a creature fails the save by 5 or more, it is also stunned until the start of the living colossus's next turn.

reactions.name: Bolstering Spirit
reactions.description: When a friendly creature the living colossus can see within 60 feet of it, other than itself, takes damage, the living colossus can share some of the life force of the spirit animating it with that friendly creature. The target gains 14 (4d6) temporary HP for 1 minute. If the target would take enough damage to reduce it to 0 HP, it instead regains 14 (4d8) HP.

monster:ccdx:living-shade.damageResistances: acid, cold, fire, lightning, thunder; bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing from nonmagical attacks
monster:ccdx:living-shade.conditionImmunities: exhaustion, frightened, grappled, paralyzed, petrified, poisoned, prone, restrained

traits.name: Amorphous
traits.description: The living shade can move through a space as narrow as 1 inch wide without squeezing.

traits.name: Shadow Stealth
traits.description: While in dim light or darkness, the living shade can take the Hide action as a bonus action.

traits.name: Sunlight Sensitivity
traits.description: While in sunlight, the living shade has disadvantage on attack rolls, as well as on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on sight.

actions.name: Shadow Touch
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 2 (1d4) cold damage.

monster:tob3:living-soot.conditionImmunities: exhaustion, grappled, paralyzed, petrified, poisoned, prone, restrained, unconscious

traits.name: Brittle
traits.description: If it takes cold it partially freezes; its speed is reduced by 10 ft. and its AC is reduced by 2 until end of its next turn.

traits.name: Choking Air Form
traits.description: Can enter a hostile creature's space and stop there and it can move through a space as narrow as 1ft. wide with o squeezing. In addition when creature starts turn in same space as soot creature: 7 (2d6) poison and be unable to breathe until it starts its turn outside soot’s space (DC 15 Con negates).

traits.name: Elemental Nature
traits.description: Doesn’t require air food drink or sleep.

traits.name: False Appearance
traits.description: While motionless indistinguishable from tangled mass of blackened dusty webbing.

monster:ccdx:living-star.damageResistances: bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing from nonmagical attacks

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.description: The living star has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

traits.name: Resize
traits.description: As a bonus action, the living star can change its size. This trait works like the enlarge/reduce spell, except it deals 2d4 extra damage when enlarged and 2d4 less damage when reduced.

traits.name: Starshine
traits.description: A creature that starts its turn within 30 feet of the living star must make a DC 19 Intelligence saving throw. On a failed save, the creature is blinded for 1 minute. If a creature's saving throw is successful or the effect ends for it, the creature is immune to the living star's Starshine for the next 24 hours.

traits.name: Supernova
traits.description: When a living star dies, it erupts, and each creature within 30 feet of it must make a DC 19 Dexterity saving throw, taking 56 (16d6) radiant damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. A creature reduced to 0 hp by this damage dies.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The living star makes three starflare attacks. It can use its Silvered Ray in place of one starflare attack.

actions.name: Starflare
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +13 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 20 (3d8 + 7) bludgeoning damage plus 14 (4d6) radiant damage.

actions.name: Silvered Ray
actions.description: Ranged Spell Attack: +12 to hit, range 150 ft., one target. Hit: 28 (4d10 + 6) radiant damage, and the target must succeed on a DC 19 Charisma saving throw or be stunned until the end of its next turn.

monster:tob:living-wick.languages: shares a telepathic link with the individual that lit its wick
monster:tob:living-wick.conditionImmunities: blinded, charmed, deafened, exhaustion, frightened, paralyzed, petrified, poisoned, unconscious

traits.name: Controlled
traits.description: Living wicks cannot move, attack, or perform actions when they are not lit. Living wicks only respond to the telepathic commands of the individual that lit them.

traits.name: Light
traits.description: Activated living wicks produce light as a torch.

traits.name: Melting
traits.description: A living wick loses one hit point for every 24 hours it remains lit.

actions.name: Slam
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +2 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 3 (1d6) bludgeoning damage.

actions.name: Consume Self
actions.description: A living wick can be commanded to rapidly burn through the remains of its wick, creating a devastating fireball. All creatures within 20 feet of the living wick take 7 (2d6) fire damage, or half damage with a successful DC 13 Dexterity saving throw. The fire spreads around corners and ignites flammable objects in the area that aren't being worn or carried. The wick is reduced to a lifeless puddle of wax.

monster:tob-2023:living-wick.languages: understands the languages of its creator but can't speak
monster:tob-2023:living-wick.conditionImmunities: blinded, charmed, deafened, exhaustion, frightened, paralyzed, petrified, poisoned

traits.name: Construct Nature
traits.description: The living wick doesn’t require air, food, drink, or sleep.

traits.name: Wick-Powered
traits.description: The living wick is inactive and unconscious while its wick is unlit. When its wick is lit, it obeys the commands of the creature that lit the wick, and it sheds bright light in a 20-foot radius and dim light for an additional 20 feet. The living wick’s hp maximum is reduced by 2 (1d4) for every 24 hours it remains lit and active, and no effect short of a wish spell can remove this reduction. The living wick dies when its hp maximum is reduced to 0.

actions.name: Slam
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (1d6 + 2) bludgeoning damage.

actions.name: Consuming Inferno
actions.description: The living wick's controller can command the living wick to rapidly burn through the remains of its wick, creating a devastating ball of fire. Each creature within 20 feet of the living wick must make a DC 12 Dexterity saving throw, taking 7 (2d6) fire damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. Flammable objects in the area and that aren't being worn or carried ignite. The living wick then dies, becoming a lifeless puddle of wax.

actions.name: Bite

actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +2 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. Hit: 2 (1d4) piercing damage.

traits.description: The lizardfolk's Perception is 18 when perceiving by smell or taste.

traits.name: Hold Breath

actions.description: The lizardfolk makes one Bite attack and one Heavy Club attack, or it makes two Javelin attacks.

actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (1d6+2) bludgeoning damage.

actions.name: Javelin
actions.description: Melee or Ranged Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 30/120 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (1d6+2) piercing damage.

reactions.name: Shoving Counter
reactions.description: If a creature misses the lizardfolk with an attack and the lizardfolk is wielding a shield, the lizardfolk can shove its shield into the creature. The attacker must succeed on a DC 12 STR save or be pushed up to 10 feet away from the lizardfolk and knocked prone.

traits.name: Aligned
traits.description: The lizardfolk radiates either an Evil or Good aura.

traits.name: Hold Breath
traits.description: The lizardfolk can hold its breath for 15 minutes.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The lizardfolk attacks once with its shield and twice with its trident.

actions.name: Shield
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (1d4 + 3) bludgeoning damage  and the target makes a DC 13 Strength check. On a failure  it is knocked prone.

actions.name: Trident
actions.description: Melee or Ranged Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft., one target. Hit: 10 (2d6 + 3) piercing damage  and the lizardfolk gains temporary hit points equal to half the damage dealt.

reactions.name: Supernatural Rebuke
reactions.description: When the lizardfolk is dealt damage by a creature it can see within 60 feet, its attacker makes a DC 13 Dexterity saving throw. On a failure, the attacker takes 11 (2d10) fire or radiant damage (the lizardfolks choice).

traits.name: Brutal
traits.description: A melee weapon deals one extra die of its damage when the lizardfolk ruler hits with it (included in the attack).

traits.name: Heightened Smell and Taste
traits.description: The lizardfolk's Perception is 17 when perceiving by smell or taste.

traits.name: Hold Breath
traits.description: The lizardfolk ruler can hold its breath for 15 minutes.

traits.name: Unshakable Command
traits.description: Each friendly creature within 30 feet of the lizardfolk ruler can't be charmed or frightened while the ruler isn't incapacitated.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The lizardfolk ruler makes two Bite attacks and one Greataxe attack, or it makes three Javelin attacks.

bonusActions.name: Leader's Challenge
bonusActions.description: The ruler hisses out a challenge or a threat (the ruler's choice) toward one creature it can see within 30 feet of it. The target must make a DC 13 CHA save. If the target fails the save against a challenge, the target has disadvantage on attack rolls against any creature other than the ruler until the start of the ruler's next turn. If the target fails the save against a threat, the ruler has advantage on the next attack roll it makes against the target before the start of its next turn.

reactions.name: Inspiring Hiss
reactions.description: When a friendly lizardfolk the ruler can see within 30 feet of it is hit by an attack, the ruler can hiss out inspiring words to encourage the lizardfolk to keep going. The target gains 5 (2d4) temporary HP for 1 minute.

traits.name: Heightened Smell and Taste
traits.description: The lizardfolk's Perception is 20 when perceiving by smell or taste.

traits.name: Hold Breath
traits.description: The lizardfolk shaman can hold its breath for 15 minutes.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The lizardfolk makes one Bite attack and one Ritual Staff attack, or it makes two Swamp Bolt attacks.

actions.name: Bite
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (1d6+2) piercing damage.

actions.name: Ritual Staff
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 6 (1d8+2) bludgeoning damage plus 7 (2d6) poison damage.

actions.name: Swamp Bolt
actions.description: Ranged Spell Attack: +5 to hit, range 60 ft., one target. Hit: 10 (2d6+3) poison damage, and the target must succeed on a DC 13 CON save or be poisoned until the end of its next turn.

actions.name: Spellcasting
actions.description:
The lizardfolk shaman casts one of the following spells, using WIS as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 13).

- At Will: druidcraft, guidance, mending
- 2/Day Each: cure wounds, entangle, grease1/day: ray of enfeeblement

bonusActions.name: Poisoned Body
bonusActions.description: The shaman coats itself in poison until the start of its next turn. It takes 3 (1d6) poison damage. In addition, the next time a creature hits the shaman with a melee attack while within 5 feet of the shaman before the start of the shaman's next turn, the attacker takes 7 (2d6) poison damage.

traits.name: Danger From Above
traits.description: If it jumps 10 ft.+ straight toward a creature from a higher position than the target such as leaping down from a tree it has advantage on next attack roll it makes vs. that creature.

traits.name: Standing Leap
traits.description: Its long jump is up to 30' and its high jump is up to 15 ft. with or with o a running start.

traits.name: Swamp Camouflage
traits.description: Has advantage on Dex (Stealth) checks made to hide in swampy terrain.

monster:tob2:locksmith.damageResistances: bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing from nonmagical attacks
monster:tob2:locksmith.conditionImmunities: charmed, exhaustion, frightened, paralyzed, petrified, poisoned

traits.name: Expert Lockpicker
traits.description: The locksmith can use any piece of its mechanical body to pick locks and disarm traps, as if its entire body was made up of several sets of thieves’ tools. It is proficient in using pieces of itself in this way. In addition, the locksmith has advantage on ability checks to pick locks and disarm traps.

traits.name: Innate Spellcasting
traits.description:
The locksmith’s innate spellcasting ability is Intelligence (spell save DC 15). It can innately cast the following spells, requiring no material components:
At will: mending
3/day each: arcane lock, knock
1/day: forcecage

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The locksmith makes two key blade attacks.

actions.name: Key Blade
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +9 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 18 (3d8 + 5) slashing damage.

actions.name: Acid Wash
actions.description: The locksmith emits a cloud of rust in a 60-foot cone. Each creature in that area must succeed on a DC 16 Dexterity saving throw, taking 35 (10d6) acid damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

monster:ccdx:lord-zombie.languages: the languages it knew in life
monster:ccdx:lord-zombie.damageResistances: bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing from nonmagical attacks not made with silver

traits.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day)
traits.description: If the lord fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

traits.name: Stench
traits.description: Any non-undead creature that starts its turn within 30 feet of the lord must succeed on a DC 16 Constitution saving throw or be poisoned until the start of the creature's next turn. On a successful saving throw, the creature is immune to the lord's Stench for 24 hours.

traits.name: Undead Fortitude
traits.description: If damage reduces the lord to 0 hp, it must make a Constitution saving throw with a DC of 5 + the damage taken, unless the damage is radiant or from a critical hit. On a success, the lord drops to 1 hp instead.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The lord zombie makes two slam attacks. It can use its Life Drain in place of one slam attack.

actions.name: Slam
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 7 (1d8 + 3) bludgeoning damage.

actions.name: Life Drain
actions.description:
Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. Hit: 6 (1d6 + 3) necrotic damage. The target must succeed on a DC 16 Constitution saving throw or its hp maximum is reduced by an amount equal to the damage taken. This reduction lasts until the target finishes a long rest. The target dies if this effect reduces its hp maximum to 0.

A humanoid slain by this attack rises 24 hours later as a zombie under the lord's control, unless the humanoid is restored to life or its body is destroyed. The lord can have no more than twenty zombies under its control at one time.

legendaryActions.name: Shambling Hordes
legendaryActions.description: The lord telepathically commands all zombies it controls within 1 mile to immediately move up to half their speed. A zombie that moves out of an enemy's reach because of this movement doesn't provoke an opportunity attack. Life Drain (Costs 2 Actions). The lord makes a life drain attack. Arise (Costs 3 Actions). The lord targets a humanoid corpse within 30 feet, which rises as a zombie under the lord's control.

monster:tob-2023:lord-of-the-hunt.senses: blindsight 10 ft., darkvision 120 ft., passive Perception 20
monster:tob-2023:lord-of-the-hunt.damageResistances: bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing from nonmagical attacks not made with cold iron weapons

traits.name: Huntsman’s Weapons
traits.description: The Lord of the Hunt’s weapon attacks are magical. When he hits with any weapon, the weapon deals an extra 14 (4d6) poison damage (included in the attack).

traits.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day)
traits.description: If the Lord of the Hunt fails a saving throw, he can choose to succeed instead.

traits.name: Sure Seat
traits.description: While mounted and not incapacitated, the Lord of the Hunt can’t be knocked prone, dismounted, or moved against his will.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The Lord of the Hunt makes three Spear or Longbow attacks.

actions.name: Spear
actions.description: Melee or Ranged Weapon Attack: +11 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 30/120 ft., one target. Hit: 8 (1d6 + 5) piercing damage, or 9 (1d8 + 5) piercing damage if used in two hands, plus 14 (4d6) poison damage. If the Lord of the Hunt throws the spear, the spear teleports up to 120 feet to the Lord of the Hunt's hand at the start of his next turn. If he has no hand free, the spear teleports to the ground at his feet.

actions.name: Longbow
actions.description: Ranged Weapon Attack: +10 to hit, range 150/600 ft., one target. Hit: 8 (1d8 + 4) piercing damage plus 14 (4d6) poison damage.

actions.name: Hunter's Quarry
actions.description: The Lord of the Hunt magically calls 3d6 elk or boars, 1d4 giant boars or giant elk, or 1 elephant. The called Beasts arrive in 1d4 rounds, acting as allies of the Lord and obeying its spoken commands. The Beasts remain for 1 hour, until the Lord dies, or until the Lord dismisses them as a bonus action. The Lord can have any number of Beasts under its control at one time provided the combined total CR of the Beasts is no higher than 8.

bonusActions.name: Fey Mount
bonusActions.description: The Lord of the Hunt can summon or dismiss a magical Fey mount, mounting or dismounting it as part of this bonus action without spending movement. The mount uses the statistics of a warhorse, except it has 40 hp, is a Fey, has the same damage and condition resistances and immunities as the Lord of the Hunt, and uses the Lord's saving throw bonuses in place of its own. If the mount is slain, it disappears, leaving behind no physical form, and the Lord of the Hunt must wait 1 hour before summoning the mount again.

reactions.name: Parry
reactions.description: The Lord of the Hunt increases his AC by 6 against one attack that would hit him. To do so, he must see the attacker and must be wielding a melee weapon.

legendaryActions.name: Attack
legendaryActions.description: The Lord of the Hunt makes one Spear or Longbow attack.

legendaryActions.name: Tenacious Stride
legendaryActions.description: The Lord of the Hunt moves up to his speed without provoking opportunity attacks. If he is mounted, he can force the mount to move up to half its speed without provoking opportunity attacks instead.

legendaryActions.name: Call to the Hunt
legendaryActions.description: The Lord of the Hunt blows his hunting horn and chooses one creature he can see within 60 feet. If the creature can hear the horn, it must succeed on a DC 16 Charisma saving throw or be charmed by the Lord of the Hunt for 8 hours. The charmed target obeys the Lord's verbal commands. If the target suffers any harm or receives a suicidal command, it can repeat the saving throw, ending the effect on a success. If the target successfully saves against the effect, or if the effect on it ends, the target is immune to the Lord's Call to the Hunt for the next 24 hours. The Lord can have only one target charmed at a time. If he charms another, the effect on the previous target ends.

traits.name: Alluring Presence
traits.description: All humanoids within 30 feet of a lorelei who look directly at her must succeed on a DC 17 Charisma saving throw or be drawn to her in the most direct path, regardless of the danger. This compulsion fades once the person gets within 5 feet of the lorelei. A creature can avoid this effect for one full round by choosing to avert its eyes at the start of its turn, but it then has disadvantage on any attacks or other rolls directed against the lorelei until the start of its next turn. A lorelei can suppress or resume this ability as a bonus action. Anyone who successfully saves against this effect cannot be affected by it from the same lorelei for 24 hours.

traits.name: Spellcasting
traits.description:
the lorelei is an 8th-level spellcaster. Her spellcasting ability is Charisma (spell save DC 17, +9 to hit with spell attacks). She requires no material components to cast her spells. The lorelei has the following sorcerer spells prepared:

- Cantrips (at will): detect magic, guidance, light, mending, poison spray, prestidigitation
- 1st Level (4 slots): comprehend languages, fog cloud, mage armor, ray of sickness
- 2nd Level (3 slots): hold person, misty step, suggestion
- 3rd Level (3 slots): hypnotic pattern, gaseous form, water walk
- 4th Level (2 slots): dominate beast, ice storm

traits.name: Unearthly Grace
traits.description: A lorelei applies her Charisma modifier to all of her saving throws in place of the normal ability modifier.

traits.name: Water Spirit
traits.description: The lorelei is under the effect of freedom of movement whenever she is in contact with a body of water.

actions.name: Dagger
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +8 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 7 (1d4 + 5) piercing damage.

actions.name: Charm
actions.description: The lorelei targets one humanoid she can see within 30 feet of her. If the target can see or hear the lorelei, it must succeed on a DC 17 Wisdom saving throw against this magic or be charmed by the lorelei. The charmed target regards the lorelei as its one, true love, to be heeded and protected. Although the target isn't under the lorelei's control, it takes the lorelei's requests or actions in the most favorable way it can. Each time the lorelei or her companions cause the target to take damage, directly or indirectly, it repeats the saving throw, ending the effect on itself on a success. Otherwise, the effect lasts 24 hours or until the lorelei is killed, is on a different plane of existence than the target, or takes a bonus action to end the effect.

actions.name: Stunning Glance
actions.description: The lorelei mentally disrupts a creature within 30 feet with a look. The target must succeed on a DC 17 Wisdom saving throw or be stunned for 2 rounds. Anyone who successfully saves against this effect cannot be affected by it from the same lorelei for 24 hours.

traits.name: Alluring Presence
traits.description: When a Humanoid that can see the lorelei starts its turn within 30 feet of the lorelei, the lorelei can force it to make a DC 15 Wisdom saving throw if the lorelei isn't incapacitated and can see the Humanoid. On a failed save, the Humanoid is charmed until the start if its next turn. While charmed, the target is incapacitated and must move on its turn toward the lorelei by the most direct route, trying to get within 5 feet of the lorelei for a kiss from her. The Humanoid doesn’t avoid opportunity attacks, but before moving into damaging terrain, such as lava or a pit, and whenever it takes damage, the Humanoid can repeat the saving throw. If the saving throw is successful, the effect ends for it, and it regains its senses for the remainder of its turn.

traits.name: Amphibious
traits.description: The lorelei can breathe air and water.

traits.name: Free Water Spirit
traits.description: While in contact with water, the lorelei ignores difficult terrain, and magical effects can’t reduce her speed or cause her to be restrained. In addition, she can spend 5 feet of movement to escape from nonmagical restraints or being grappled.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The lorelei can use her Stunning Glance. She then makes three Psychic Blast attacks. She can replace one attack with a use of Corrupted Kiss.

actions.name: Corrupted Kiss
actions.description: Melee Spell Attack: +8 to hit, reach 5 ft., one willing creature, or a creature that is incapacitated or restrained. Hit: 14 (2d8 + 5) necrotic damage, and the lorelei regains hp equal to that amount.

actions.name: Psychic Blast
actions.description: Melee or Ranged Spell Attack: +8 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 60 ft., one target. Hit: 12 (2d6 + 5) psychic damage.

actions.name: Stunning Glance
actions.description: The lorelei sends a seductive glance at a creature she can see within 30 feet of her. The target must succeed on a DC 15 Wisdom saving throw or be stunned until the end of its next turn. On a successful save, a creature is immune to this lorelei's Stunning Glance for the next 24 hours.

monster:ccdx:lost-minotaur.languages: understands the languages it knew in life but can't speak
monster:ccdx:lost-minotaur.conditionImmunities: charmed, exhaustion, frightened, paralyzed, poisoned, stunned

traits.name: Charge
traits.description: If the lost minotaur moves at least 10 feet straight toward a target and then hits it with a gore attack on the same turn, the target takes an extra 13 (3d8) piercing damage. If the target is a creature, it must succeed on a DC 16 Strength saving throw or be pushed up to 10 feet away and knocked prone.

traits.name: Keen Smell
traits.description: The lost minotaur has advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on smell.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.description: The lost minotaur has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

traits.name: Sense Life
traits.description: The lost minotaur can magically sense the presence of living creatures within 1 mile away. It knows each creature's general direction but not exact location.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The minotaur makes two twilight greataxe attacks.

actions.name: Twilight Greataxe
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +8 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 18 (2d12 + 5) slashing damage and 9 (2d8) necrotic damage.

actions.name: Gore
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +8 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 14 (2d8 + 5) piercing damage.

monster:ccdx:lotus-golem.languages: understands the languages of its creator but can't speak
monster:ccdx:lotus-golem.damageResistances: bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing from nonmagical attacks that aren't adamantine
monster:ccdx:lotus-golem.conditionImmunities: charmed, exhaustion, frightened, paralyzed, petrified, poisoned

traits.name: Arcane Pool
traits.description: The lotus golem absorbs energy from nearby spellcasting. Most lotus golems hold 1 charge point at any given time but can hold up to 4. As a bonus action while casting a spell within 5 feet of the lotus golem, the golem's controller can expend the golem's charge points to cast the spell without expending a spell slot. To do so, the controller must expend a number of charge points equal to the level of the spell.

traits.name: Immutable Form
traits.description: The golem is immune to any spell or effect that would alter its form.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.description: The golem has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

traits.name: Magic Weapons
traits.description: The golem's weapon attacks are magical.

traits.name: Water Walker
traits.description: The golem can move across the surface of water as if it were harmless, solid ground. This trait works like the water walk spell.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The lotus golem makes two arcane water attacks.

actions.name: Arcane Water
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +8 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 15 (2d12 + 2) bludgeoning damage plus 7 (2d6) force damage.

reactions.name: Arcane Absorption
reactions.description: When a spell is cast within 30 feet of it, the golem absorbs some of the spell's potency. If it is a spell that forces a saving throw, the DC to succeed drops by 2. If it is a spell with an attack roll, the attack roll has disadvantage. The golem regains 20 hp and gains 1 charge point in its Arcane Pool.

traits.name: Slime Trail (1/Day)
traits.description: For 1 minute, the lou carcolh leaves a slime trail behind it as it moves. The slime creates difficult terrain, and any creature walking through it must succeed on a DC 13 Dexterity (Acrobatics) check or fall prone. The slime remains effective for 1 hour.

traits.name: Sticky Tongues
traits.description: Given half an hour, the lou carcolh can extend its 6 sticky tongues up to 60 feet from itself. A creature who touches one of these tongues must succeed on a DC 13 Dexterity saving throw or be restrained as it adheres to the tongue. The tongues can be attacked (AC 12, 10 hp), and any damage done to a tongue is also done to the lou carcolh. Killing a tongue ends the restrained condition, and the lou carcolh can't use that tongue for for the next 24.

actions.name: Bite
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 11 (2d8 + 2) piercing damage and 2 (1d4) poison damage and the target must succeed on a DC 13 Constitution saving throw or be poisoned until the end of its turn.

actions.name: Spit Venom
actions.description: Ranged Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, range 30/120 ft., one target. Hit: 16 (3d10) poison damage.

actions.name: Sticky Tongue
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 60 ft., one target. Hit: The target is restrained and the lou carcolh can't use the same sticky tongue on another target.

actions.name: Reel
actions.description: The lou carcolh pulls in each creature of Large size or smaller who is restrained by one of its sticky tongues. The creature is knocked prone and dragged up to 30 feet towards the lou carcolh. If a creature is dragged within 5 feet of the lou carcolh, it can make one bite attack against the creature as a bonus action.

traits.name: Trampling Charge
traits.description: If the loxoda moves at least 20 feet straight toward a Large or smaller creature it then attacks with a stomp, the stomp attack is made with advantage. If the stomp attack hits, the target must also succeed on a DC 15 Strength saving throw or be knocked prone.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The loxoda makes two attacks, but no more than one of them can be a maul or javelin attack.

actions.name: Maul
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 25 (6d6 + 4) bludgeoning damage.

actions.name: Stomp
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 20 (3d10 + 4) bludgeoning damage.

actions.name: Javelin
actions.description: Melee or Ranged Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 30/120 ft., one target. Hit: 14 (3d6 + 4) piercing damage.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The loxoda makes one Slam attack and one Spear attack.

actions.name: Slam
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 22 (4d8 + 4) bludgeoning damage.

actions.name: Spear
actions.description: Melee or Ranged Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft., one target. Hit: 14 (3d6 + 4) piercing damage, or 17 (3d8 + 4) piercing damage if used with two hands to make a melee attack.

actions.name: Stomp
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one prone creature. Hit: 20 (3d10 + 4) bludgeoning damage.

actions.name: Tooth-Rattling Pound
actions.description: The loxoda rears up and lands heavily, rattling the land and creatures around it. Each creature in contact with the ground within 20 feet of the loxoda must make a DC 15 Dexterity saving throw. On a failure, a creature takes 36 (8d8) bludgeoning damage and takes an extra 10 (3d6) thunder damage at the end of its next turn as the shockwaves from the Tooth-Rattling Pound continue up through its body. On a success, a creature takes half the damage and doesn't take extra thunder damage from shockwaves.

traits.name: Leech Luck
traits.description: If a creature within 60 feet of the luck leech rolls a 20 on an ability check, attack roll, or saving throw, the luck leech gains 1 luck point. It can’t have more than 4 luck points at a time.

traits.name: Reserve of Fortune
traits.description: If the luck leech doesn’t have 4 luck points at sunset, it gains 2 luck points. It can’t have more than 4 luck points at a time. In addition, if the luck leech rolls a 1 on the d20 for an attack roll, ability check, or saving throw while it has at least 1 luck point, it can reroll the die and must use the new roll. This trait doesn’t expend luck points.

traits.name: Turn Luck
traits.description:
As a bonus action, the luck leech can spend 1 luck point to:
 Gain advantage on its next attack or saving throw
 Cast misty step
 Increase the necrotic damage of its next successful biting arms attack by an extra 9 (2d8)
 Force each creature that is concentrating on a spell within 60 feet of it to make a DC 16 Constitution saving throw, losing its concentration on the spell on a failure.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The luck leech makes two biting arm attacks.

actions.name: Biting Arms
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +9 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 18 (3d8 + 5) piercing damage plus 9 (2d8) necrotic damage.

actions.name: Feast of Fortune
actions.description: Each creature the luck leech can see within 30 feet of it must make a DC 16 Charisma saving throw. On a failure, the creature takes 27 (6d8) psychic damage, becomes blinded until the end of its next turn, and is cursed with falling fortunes. On a success, a creature takes half the damage and isn't blinded or cursed. For each creature that fails this saving throw, the luck leech gains 1 luck point.

monster:tob:lunar-devil.speed: 40 ft., Climb 20 ft., Fly 60 ft. (hover), Swim 20 ft.
monster:tob:lunar-devil.languages: Celestial, Draconic, Elvish, Infernal, Sylvan, telepathy 120 ft.
monster:tob:lunar-devil.damageResistances: cold; bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing from nonmagical attacks not made with silvered weapons

traits.name: Devil's Sight
traits.description: Magical darkness doesn't impede the devil's darkvision.

traits.name: Innate Spellcasting
traits.description:
the devil's innate spellcasting ability is Charisma (spell save DC 15). It can innately cast the following spells, requiring no material components:

at will: fly, major image, planar binding

3/day: greater invisibility

1/day: wall of ice

traits.name: Light Incorporeality
traits.description: The devil is semi-incorporeal when standing in moonlight, and is immune to all nonmagical attacks in such conditions. Even when hit by spells or magic weapons, it takes only half damage from a corporeal source, with the exception of force damage. Holy water can affect the devil as it does incorporeal undead.

traits.name: Lightwalking
traits.description: Once per round, the lunar devil magically teleports, along with any equipment it is wearing or carrying, from one beam of moonlight to another within 80 feet. This relocation uses half of its speed.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.description: The devil has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

traits.name: Variant: Devil Summoning
traits.description: Summon Devil (1/Day): The devil can attempt a magical summoning. The devil has a 40 percent chance of summoning either 2 chain devils or 1 lunar devil.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The devil makes three attacks: one with its bite, one with its claws, and one with its tail. Alternatively, it can use Hurl Moonlight twice.

actions.name: Bite
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +8 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 11 (1d12 + 5) piercing damage.

actions.name: Claw
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +8 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 12 (2d6 + 5) slashing damage.

actions.name: Tail
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +8 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 9 (1d8 + 5) bludgeoning damage.

actions.name: Hurl Moonlight
actions.description: Ranged Spell Attack: +7 to hit, range 150 ft., one target. Hit: 19 (3d12) cold damage and the target must succeed on a DC 15 Constitution saving throw or become blinded for 4 rounds.

monster:tob-2023:lunar-devil.speed: 60 ft., Climb 30 ft., Fly 40 ft., Swim 30 ft.
monster:tob-2023:lunar-devil.languages: Celestial, Draconic, Elvish, Infernal, Sylvan, telepathy 120 ft.

traits.name: Light Incorporeality

traits.name: Lightwalking
traits.description: Once on its turn, the lunar devil can use half its movement to step magically into one area of moonlight within its reach and emerge from a second area of moonlight within 80 feet of the first, appearing in an unoccupied space within that second area.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.description: The lunar devil has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The lunar devil makes one Bite attack, one Claw attack, and one Tail attack, or it makes three Hurl Moonlight attacks.

actions.name: Bite
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +8 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 16 (2d10 + 5) piercing damage plus 9 (2d8) cold damage.

actions.name: Claw
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +8 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 12 (2d6 + 5) slashing damage.

actions.name: Tail
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +8 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 14 (2d8 + 5) bludgeoning damage.

actions.name: Hurl Moonlight
actions.description: Ranged Spell Attack: +7 to hit, range 150 ft., one target. Hit: 17 (3d8 + 4) cold damage, and the target must succeed on a DC 15 Constitution saving throw or become blinded until the end of its next turn.

actions.name: Summon Devil
actions.description: The lunar devil magically calls 1d4 giant owls that are Fiends with the lunar devil's damage resistances and immunities (but not its Light Incorporeality trait). The lunar devil has a 25 percent chance of calling one lunar devil instead. The called creatures arrive in 1d4 rounds, acting as allies of the devil and obeying its telepathic commands. The creatures remain for 1 hour, until the devil dies, or until the devil dismisses them as a bonus action.

actions.name: Spellcasting
actions.description:
The lunar devil casts one of the following spells, requiring no material components and using Charisma as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 15):

- At Will: fly, major image
3/day: greater invisibility
1/day: wall of ice

monster:tob2:lunarian.speed: 30 ft., Climb 15 ft., Fly 40 ft., Swim 15 ft.

traits.name: Descendant of The Moon
traits.description: Magical light created by the lunarian can’t be extinguished.

traits.name: Major Surface Curse
traits.description: A lunarian can never be in the presence of natural light. It takes 9 (2d8) radiant damage at the beginning of its turn if it is exposed to direct moonlight or sunlight. If this damage reduces the lunarian to 0 hp, it dies and turns to moondust.

traits.name: Moon-Touched Weapons
traits.description: The lunarian’s weapon attacks are magical. When the lunarian hits with any weapon, the weapon deals an extra 4 (1d8) radiant damage (included in the attack). A creature that takes radiant damage from a lunarian’s weapon sheds dim light in a 10-foot radius for 1 hour.

traits.name: Summon Shadowbeam (Recharge 6)
traits.description: As a bonus action, the lunarian summons a beam of pale light, shot through with undulating waves of shadow, centered on a point it can see within 60 feet of it. The beam is a 10-foot-radius, 40-foot-high cylinder and lasts for 1 minute. As a bonus action on each of its turns, the lunarian can move the beam up to 20 feet in any direction. A creature that enters or starts its turn in the beam must make a DC 13 Constitution saving throw. On a failure, a creature takes 11 (2d10) necrotic damage and is cursed with the minor surface curse. On a success, a creature takes half the damage and isn’t cursed.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The lunarian makes two halberd attacks.

actions.name: Halberd
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 9 (1d10 + 4) slashing damage plus 4 (1d8) radiant damage.

monster:tob3:lycanthrope-werecrocodile.damageImmunities: nonmagic bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing attacks not made with silvered weapons

traits.name: Hold Breath (Crocodile or Hybrid Form Only)
traits.description: Can hold its breath for 15 min.

bonusActions.name: Change Shape
bonusActions.description: Transforms into a Large crocodile or into a crocodile-humanoid hybrid or back into its true form which is Humanoid. Its stats other than size are the same in each form. Any equipment worn/carried isn't transformed. Reverts to its true form if it dies.

monster:tob3:lycanthrope-wereotter.damageImmunities: nonmagic bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing attacks not made with silvered weapons

traits.name: Hold Breath
traits.description: Can hold its breath for 10 min.

traits.name: Keen Hearing and Smell
traits.description: Advantage on Wis (Perception) checks that rely on hearing or smell.

bonusActions.name: Change Shape
bonusActions.description: Transforms into a Med otter-humanoid hybrid or into Large otter or back into true form: Humanoid. Stats other than size are same in each form. Items worn/ carried not transformed. Reverts to its true form if it dies.

monster:tob2:lymarien.speed: 5 ft., Climb 2 ft., Fly 50 ft., Swim 2 ft.

traits.name: Distracting Swoop
traits.description: If the lymarien moves at least 20 feet straight toward a creature and then hits it with a claw attack on the same turn, that target must succeed on a DC 11 Wisdom saving throw or be distracted until the end of its next turn. A distracted creature has disadvantage on its next attack roll or ability check.

traits.name: Speak with Beasts
traits.description: The lymarien can communicate with beasts as if they shared a language.

actions.name: Claw
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (1d4 + 3) slashing damage.

monster:tob2:lymarien-swarm.speed: 5 ft., Climb 2 ft., Fly 50 ft., Swim 2 ft.
monster:tob2:lymarien-swarm.conditionImmunities: charmed, frightened, grappled, paralyzed, petrified, prone, restrained, stunned

traits.name: Distracting Beauty
traits.description: A creature that starts its turn in the lymarien swarm’s space must succeed on a DC 15 Wisdom saving throw or be distracted by the swarm’s luminous eyes and fluttering wings until the end of its next turn. A distracted creature has disadvantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks and on attack rolls against the lymarien swarm.

traits.name: Innate Spellcasting
traits.description:
The lymarien swarm’s innate spellcasting ability is Charisma (spell save DC 13). It can innately cast the following spells, requiring no material components:
At will: dancing lights, minor illusion
3/day each: hypnotic pattern, sleep (affects 9d8 hp)

traits.name: Speak with Beasts
traits.description: The lymarien swarm can communicate with beasts as if they shared a language.

traits.name: Swarm
traits.description: The swarm can occupy another creature’s space and vice versa, and the swarm can move through any opening large enough for a Tiny lymarien. The swarm can’t regain hp or gain temporary hp.

actions.name: Claws
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 0 ft., one creature in the swarm's space. Hit: 21 (6d6) slashing damage, or 10 (3d6) slashing damage if the swarm has half its hp or fewer.

actions.name: Flight of the Fey
actions.description: The lymarien swarm lifts a Large or smaller creature in its space. The target must succeed on a DC 15 Dexterity saving throw or be lifted directly upward to a height up to the swarm's flying speed. When the swarm moves, the lifted creature moves with it. At the end of the swarm's turn, the swarm drops the creature, which takes falling damage as normal.

monster:ccdx:lystrosaurus.speed: 30 ft., Burrow 5 ft., Climb 15 ft., Swim 15 ft.

traits.name: Headbutt
traits.description: If the lystrosaurus moves at least 10 feet straight toward a creature and then hits it with a ram attack on the same turn, the target must succeed on a DC 13 Strength saving throw or be knocked prone. If the target is prone, the lystrosaurus can make one bite attack against it immediately as a bonus action.

actions.name: Ram
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 8 (2d4 + 3) bludgeoning damage.

actions.name: Bite
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 13 (3d6 + 3) piercing damage.

monster:tob2:mad-piper.languages: understands Common and Void Speech, but can't speak
monster:tob2:mad-piper.conditionImmunities: charmed, exhaustion, frightened, paralyzed, poisoned, prone

traits.name: Inspire
traits.description: As a bonus action, the mad piper can play a tune that inspires a friendly creature it can see within 30 feet of it. If the target can hear the mad piper, it has advantage on its next ability check, attack roll, or saving throw.

actions.name: Screaming Flail
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 10 (2d6 + 3) bludgeoning damage plus 2 (1d4) thunder damage.

actions.name: Terrible Dirge
actions.description: The mad piper plays a haunting dirge. Each creature of the mad piper's choice that is within 30 feet of the piper and can hear the dirge must succeed o a DC 13 Wisdom saving throw or become frightened for 1 minute. A creature can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success. If a creature's saving throw is successful or the effect ends for it, the creature is immune to the mad piper's Terrible Dirge for the next 24 hours.

traits.name: Spellcasting
traits.description:
The mage is a 9th level spellcaster. Their spellcasting ability is Intelligence (spell save DC 14 +6 to hit with spell attacks). They have the following wizard spells prepared:

- Cantrips (at will): Fire Bolt, Light, Mage Hand, Prestidigitation
- 1st-Level (4 slots): Detect Magic, Identify, Mage Armor, Shield
- 2nd-Level (3 slots): Alter Self, Misty Step
- 3rd-Level (3 slots): Clairvoyance, Counterspell, Fireball
- 4th-Level (3 slots): Dimension Door, Greater Invisibility
- 5th-Level (1 slot): Cone of Cold

actions.name: Dagger
actions.description: Melee or Ranged Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft., one target. Hit: 4 (1d4 + 2) piercing damage.

actions.name: Fire Bolt
actions.description: (Cantrip; V, S) Ranged Spell Attack: +6 to hit, range 120 ft., one target. Hit: 11 (2d10) fire damage.

actions.name: Fireball
actions.description: (3rd-Level; V, S, M) Fire streaks from the mage to a point within 120 feet and explodes in a 20-foot radius  spreading around corners. Each creature in the area makes a DC 14 Dexterity saving throw  taking 21 (6d6) fire damage on a failed save or half damage on a success.

actions.name: Dimension Door
actions.description: (4th-Level; V) The mage teleports to a location within 500 feet. They can bring along one willing Medium or smaller creature within 5 feet. If a creature would teleport to an occupied space  it takes 14 (4d6) force damage  and the spell fails.

actions.name: Greater Invisibility
actions.description: (4th-Level; V, S, Concentration) The mage or a creature they touch is invisible for 1 minute.

actions.name: Cone of Cold
actions.description: (5th-Level; V, S, M) Frost blasts from the mage in a 60-foot cone. Each creature in the area makes a DC 17 Constitution saving throw  taking 36 (8d8) cold damage on a failure or half damage on a success.

bonusActions.name: Misty Step
bonusActions.description: (2nd-Level; V) The mage teleports to an unoccupied space they can see within 30 feet. The mage can't cast this spell and a 1st-level or higher spell on the same turn.

reactions.name: Counterspell
reactions.description: (3rd-Level; S) When a creature the mage can see within 60 feet casts a spell, the mage attempts to interrupt it. If the creature is casting a 2nd-level spell or lower, the spell fails. If the creature is casting a 3rd-level or higher spell, the mage makes an Intelligence check against a DC of 10 + the spells level. On a success, the spell fails, and the spellcasting creature can use its reaction to try to cast a second spell with the same casting time so long as it uses a spell slot level equal to or less than half the original spell slot. If the mage casts counterspell with a higher spell slot, the interrupted spell fails if its level is less than that of counterspell.

reactions.name: Shield
reactions.description: (1st-Level; V) When the mage is hit by an attack or targeted by magic missile, they gain a +5 bonus to AC (including against the triggering attack) and immunity to magic missile. These benefits last until the start of their next turn.

traits.name: Arcane Weapons
traits.description: The mage's weapon attacks are magical. When the mage hits with any weapon, the weapon deals an extra 3d8 force damage (included in the attack).

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.description: The mage has advantage on saves against spells and other magical effects.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The mage makes three Dagger or Arcane Bolt attacks. It can replace one attack with a use of Spellcasting.

actions.name: Dagger
actions.description: Melee or Ranged Weapon Attack: +3 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft., one target. Hit: 2 (1d4) piercing damage plus 13 (3d8) force damage.

actions.name: Arcane Bolt
actions.description: Ranged Spell Attack: +6 to hit, range 60 ft., one target. Hit: 16 (3d8+3) force damage.

actions.name: Spellcasting
actions.description:
The mage casts one of the following spells, using INT as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 14).

- At Will: detect magic, light, mage hand, prestidigitation
- 3/Day Each: fly, mage armor, mirror image
- 2/Day Each: fireball, haste, slow
- 1/Day Each: cone of cold, greater invisibility

traits.name: Arcane Weapons
traits.description: The mage apprentice's weapon attacks are magical. When the mage hits with any weapon, the weapon deals an extra 2d8 force damage (included in the attack).

traits.name: Reckless Show-Off
traits.description: If it can see a fellow apprentice or its magical teacher at the start of its turn, the mage apprentice has advantage on the first spell attack roll it makes during that turn, but attack rolls against it also have advantage until the start of its next turn.

actions.name: Dagger
actions.description: Melee or Ranged Weapon Attack: +3 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft., one target. Hit: 2 (1d4) piercing damage plus 9 (2d8) force damage.

actions.name: Arcane Bolt
actions.description: Ranged Spell Attack: +4 to hit, range 60 ft., one target. Hit: 11 (2d8+2) force damage.

actions.name: Spellcasting
actions.description:
The mage apprentice casts one of the following spells, using INT as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 12).

- At Will: mage hand, minor illusion
- 1/Day Each: color spray, mage armor, sleep

monster:a5e-mm:magma-mephit.speed: 30 ft., Climb 15 ft., Fly 30 ft., Swim 15 ft.

traits.name: Death Burst
traits.description: When the mephit dies, it explodes into lava. Each creature within 5 feet makes a DC 10 Constitution saving throw, taking 4 (1d8) fire damage on a failed save or half damage on a success.

traits.name: Elemental Nature
traits.description: A mephit doesnt require air, sustenance, or sleep.

traits.name: False Appearance
traits.description: While motionless, the mephit is indistinguishable from a small magma flow.

actions.name: Claws
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +3 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 3 (1d4 + 1) slashing damage plus 2 (1d4) fire damage.

actions.name: Heat Metal
actions.description: Ranged Spell Attack: +4 to hit, range 60 ft., one creature wearing or holding a metal object. Hit: 9 (2d8) fire damage. If a creature is holding the object and suffers damage  it makes a DC 10 Constitution saving throw  dropping the object on a failure.

actions.name: Fire Breath
actions.description: The mephit exhales a 15-foot cone of fire. Each creature in the area makes a DC 10 Constitution saving throw  taking 7 (2d6) fire damage on a failed save or half damage on a success.

monster:bfrd:magma-mephit.speed: 30 ft., Climb 15 ft., Fly 30 ft., Swim 15 ft.

traits.name: Death Burst
traits.description: When the mephit dies, it explodes in a burst of lava. Each creature within 5 feet of it must succeed on a DC 11 DEX save or be pushed up to 10 feet away from the mephit, knocked prone, and catch on fire. Until a creature takes an action to douse the fire, the creature on fire takes 3 (1d6) fire damage at the start of each of its turns.

traits.name: False Appearance
traits.description: While the mephit remains motionless, it is indistinguishable from an ordinary mound of molten rock.

actions.name: Claws
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 4 (1d4+2) slashing damage plus 3 (1d6) fire damage.

actions.name: Lob Magma
actions.description: Ranged Weapon Attack: +2 to hit, range 20/60 ft., one target. Hit: 7 (2d6) fire damage.

actions.name: Pyroclastic Burst
actions.description: The mephit exhales an explosive blast of lava in a 15-foot cone. Each creature in the area must make a DC 11 STR save. On a failure, a creature takes 7 (2d6) fire damage and is pushed up to 10 feet away from the mephit and knocked prone. On a success, a creature takes half the damage and isn't pushed or knocked prone.

bonusActions.name: Pyrotechnic Display
bonusActions.description: The mephit casts the color spray spell (spell save DC 11), requiring no material components and using CHA as the spellcasting ability.

traits.name: Lava Bound
traits.description: The magma octopus can exist outside of lava for up to 1 hour each day. If it remains outside of lava for 1 minute or longer, its skin begins to dry and harden like rapidly-cooled magma. While its skin is hardened, it has a walking speed of 20 feet, an Armor Class of 18, and vulnerability to cold damage. If it remains outside of lava for 1 hour or longer, it becomes petrified, transforming into basalt. Its body returns to normal if it is submerged in lava for 1 round.

traits.name: Lava Swimmer
traits.description: While in lava, the magma octopus has a swimming speed of 60 feet and can move through the lava as if it were water.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The magma octopus makes four attacks with its tentacles.

actions.name: Tentacle
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +8 to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. Hit: 8 (1d6 + 5) bludgeoning damage plus 2 (1d4) fire damage. If the target is a creature, it is grappled (escape DC 16). Until this grapple ends, the target is restrained, and it takes 2 (1d4) fire damage at the start of each of its turns. The magma octopus can grapple up to two targets at a time.

actions.name: Magma Blast
actions.description: The magma octopus sprays magma in a 30-foot cone. Each creature in that area must make a DC 16 Dexterity saving throw, taking 28 (8d6) fire damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. If a creature fails the saving throw by 5 or more, it catches fire. Until someone takes an action to douse the fire, the creature takes 5 (1d10) fire damage at the start of each of its turns.

traits.name: Blazing Blood
traits.description: When the magmin takes damage that doesnt kill it, or when it is subjected to fire damage, its magma shell cracks and it is set ablaze. While ablaze, the magmin sheds bright light for 10 feet and dim light for an additional 10 feet. If the magmin is subjected to cold damage while ablaze, this flame is extinguished. The magmin can also set itself ablaze or extinguish itself as an action.

traits.name: Death Burst
traits.description: If the magmin dies while ablaze, it explodes in a burst of magma. Each creature within 10 feet makes a DC 11 Dexterity saving throw, taking 7 (2d6) fire damage on a failed save. Unattended flammable objects in the area are ignited.

traits.name: Elemental Nature
traits.description: A magmin doesnt require air, sustenance, or sleep.

actions.name: Touch
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (1d6 + 2) fire damage. If the magmin is ablaze and the target is a creature  it suffers 5 (1d10) ongoing fire damage until a creature takes an action to extinguish the flame on the target.

actions.name: Spurt Magma
actions.description: Ranged Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, range 30 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (1d6 + 2) fire damage.

monster:bfrd:magmin.speed: 30 ft., Burrow 15 ft., Climb 15 ft., Swim 15 ft.

traits.name: Death Burst
traits.description: When the magmin dies, it collapses into a Tiny cinder cone. On initiative count 20 after the magmin dies, the cinder cone erupts in a burst of fire and lava. Each creature within 10 feet of the cone must make a DC 11 DEX save, taking 7 (2d6) fire damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. Flammable objects that aren't being worn or carried in that area are ignited.

traits.name: Hardened Magma
traits.description: While the magmin isn't ablaze, it is resistant to piercing and slashing damage from nonmagical attacks, and it is vulnerable to thunder damage.

traits.name: Molten Body
traits.description: While the magmin is ablaze, each creature that hits it with a melee attack while within 5 feet of it takes 3 (1d6) fire damage.

actions.name: Burning Slam
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 4 (1d4+2) bludgeoning damage plus 3 (1d6) fire damage.

bonusActions.name: Ignited Illumination
bonusActions.description: The magmin sets itself ablaze or extinguishes its flames. While ablaze, the magmin sheds bright light in a 10-foot radius and dim light for an additional 10 feet.

monster:tob2:magnetic-elemental.speed: 30 ft., Burrow 20 ft., Climb 15 ft., Fly 20 ft. (hover), Swim 15 ft.
monster:tob2:magnetic-elemental.senses: darkvision 60 ft., tremorsense 30 ft., passive Perception 10
monster:tob2:magnetic-elemental.damageResistances: bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing from nonmagical attacks
monster:tob2:magnetic-elemental.conditionImmunities: exhaustion, paralyzed, petrified, poisoned, prone, unconscious

traits.name: Controlled Polarity
traits.description: The magnetic elemental has advantage on attack rolls against a creature if the creature is wearing metal armor. A creature attacking the magnetic elemental with a metal weapon while within 10 feet of it has disadvantage on the attack roll.

traits.name: Magnetism
traits.description: When the magnetic elemental moves, Medium and smaller metal objects that aren’t being worn or carried are pulled up to 5 feet closer to the magnetic elemental. If this movement pulls the object into the elemental’s space, the item sticks to the elemental. A successful DC 15 Strength check removes a stuck item from the elemental. Objects made of gold and silver are unaffected by this trait.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The magnetic elemental makes two slam attacks.

actions.name: Slam
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 13 (2d8 + 4) bludgeoning damage.

actions.name: Magnetic Pulse
actions.description:
The magnetic elemental releases a magnetic pulse, choosing to pull or push nearby metal objects. Objects made of gold or silver are unaffected by the elemental's Pulse.
 Pull. Each creature that is wearing metal armor or holding a metal weapon within 5 feet of the magnetic elemental must succeed on a DC 15 Strength saving throw or the metal items worn or carried by it stick to the magnetic elemental. A creature that is made of metal or is wearing metal armor and that fails the saving throw is stuck to the elemental and grappled (escape DC 15). If the item is a weapon and the wielder can't or won't let go of the weapon, the wielder is stuck to the elemental and grappled (escape DC 15). A stuck object can't be used.
