actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 6 (1d8 + 2) bludgeoning damage.

actions.name: Rapier
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +3 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (1d8 + 1) piercing damage.

reactions.name: Parry
reactions.description: If the noble is wielding a melee weapon and can see their attacker, they add 2 to their AC against one melee attack that would hit them.

traits.name: Impenetrable Ego
traits.description: While the noble is conscious and wearing no armor and wielding no shield, it adds its CHA modifier to its AC (included above). In addition, it is resistant to the charmed and frightened conditions.

actions.name: Rapier
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +3 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (1d8+1) piercing damage.

reactions.name: Parry
reactions.description: The noble adds 2 to its AC against one melee attack that would hit it. To do so, the noble must see the attacker and be wielding a melee weapon.

monster:tob:noctiny.languages: Common, plus the language spoken by the noctini's fext master

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.description: The noctiny has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

traits.name: Pact Wrath
traits.description: One of the noctiny's weapons is infused with power. Its attacks with this weapon count as magical, and it adds its Charisma bonus to the weapon's damage (included below).

traits.name: Spellcasting
traits.description:
the noctiny is a 3rd-level spellcaster. Its spellcasting ability score is Charisma (save DC 13, +5 to hit with spell attacks). It knows the following warlock spells.

- Cantrips (at will): chill touch, eldritch blast, poison spray
- 1st Level (4 slots): armor of agathys, charm person, hellish rebuke, hex
- 2nd Level (2 slots): crown of madness, misty step

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The noctiny makes two melee attacks.

actions.name: Pact Staff
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +3 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 7 (1d6 + 4) bludgeoning damage or 8 (1d8 + 4) bludgeoning damage if used in two hands.

traits.name: Eldritch Weapons
traits.description: The noctiny’s weapon attacks are magical. When the noctiny hits with any weapon, the weapon deals an extra 1d6 force damage (included in the attack).

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.description: The noctiny has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The noctiny makes two Quarterstaff or Eldritch Fury attacks.

actions.name: Quarterstaff
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 6 (1d6 + 3) bludgeoning damage, or 7 (1d8 + 3) bludgeoning damage if used in two hands, plus 3 (1d6) force damage.

actions.name: Eldritch Fury
actions.description: Ranged Spell Attack: +5 to hit, range 120 ft., one target. Hit: 10 (2d6 + 3) force damage.

traits.name: Swamp Camouflage
traits.description: The nodosaurus has advantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks made to hide in swampy terrain.

actions.name: Tail
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 12 (2d8 + 3) bludgeoning damage.

monster:tob2:noth-norren.damageResistances: lightning; bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing from nonmagical attacks
monster:tob2:noth-norren.conditionImmunities: deafened, exhaustion, grappled, paralyzed, petrified, poisoned, prone, restrained, unconscious

traits.name: Air Turbulence
traits.description: A flying creature that enters or starts its turn within 60 feet of the noth-norren must land at the end of its turn or fall. In addition, ranged attack rolls against the noth-norren have disadvantage.

traits.name: Magic Weapons
traits.description: The noth-norren’s weapon attacks are magical.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The noth-norren makes two slam attacks. Alternatively, it uses Throw Debris twice.

actions.name: Slam
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +9 to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. Hit: 27 (4d10 + 5) bludgeoning damage. A creature struck by the slam attack must succeed on a DC 16 Strength saving throw or be knocked prone.

actions.name: Throw Debris
actions.description: Ranged Weapon Attack: +8 to hit, range 60/180 ft., one target. Hit: 22 (4d8 + 4) bludgeoning damage.

actions.name: Fling Victim
actions.description: One Large or smaller creature caught in the nothnorren's vortex is thrown up to 60 feet in a random direction and knocked prone. If a thrown target strikes a solid surface, the target takes 3 (1d6) bludgeoning damage for every 10 feet it was thrown. If the target is thrown at another creature, that creature must succeed on a DC 16 Dexterity saving throw or take the same damage and be knocked prone.

actions.name: Vortex
actions.description:
The noth-norren pulls nearby creatures into its central vortex to be torn apart by its jagged teeth. Each creature within 5 feet of the noth-norren must succeed on a DC 16 Strength saving throw or be pulled into the vortex. A creature in the vortex is blinded and restrained, it has total cover against attacks and other effects outside the vortex, and it takes 21 (6d6) slashing damage at the start of each of the noth-norren's turns.

If the noth-norren takes 30 damage or more on a single turn from a creature inside the vortex, the noth-norren must succeed on a DC 18 Constitution saving throw at the end of that turn or release all creatures caught in its vortex, which fall prone in a space within 10 feet of the noth-norren. If the noth-norren dies, it becomes a pile of teeth, its windy form dissipating, and releases all trapped creatures.

traits.name: Divine Weapons
traits.description: When it hits with any weapon deals extra 2d8 necrotic or radiant (included below) apostle’s choice.

traits.name: Faith’s Reward
traits.description: When it casts the bless spell it gains the benefit of the spell even if it doesn’t include itself as a target. In addition when apostle restores hp to another creature it regains hp equal to half that amount.

traits.name: Malleable Physiology
traits.description: At the start of its turn the atavist gains one of the following benefits until it ends the effect (no action required) or the start of its next turn:Darkvision out to a range of 30 feet.A climbing flying or swimming speed of 30 feet.Advantage on Wis (Perception) checks that rely on hearing or smell.Bony spikes sprout along its skin and a creature that touches the atavist or hits it with melee attack while within 5 ft. of it takes 4 (1d8) piercing damage.

traits.name: Phrenic Weapons
traits.description: Its weapon attacks are magical. When it hits with any weapon deals extra 3d6 psychic (included below).

bonusActions.name: Cunning Action
bonusActions.description: Dash Disengage or Hide action.

traits.name: Impenetrable Ego
traits.description: While it is conscious and wearing no armor and wielding no shield it adds its Cha modifier to its AC (included above) and saves. Advantage on saves vs. being charmed or frightened.

bonusActions.name: Bend the Spoon
bonusActions.description: Chooses one nonmagical weapon it can see within 30' of it and magically warps it. If weapon is being worn or carried creature doing so can prevent warping via DC 16 Wis save. Warped weapon deals only half its normal damage on a hit and creature wielding warped weapon has disadvantage on attack rolls with it. A creature can repair a warped weapon with mending spell or by spending a short rest repairing it with the appropriate tools.

reactions.name: Appeal to the Fervent
reactions.description: When a creature psychophant can see targets it with attack psychophant calls for aid from its followers switching places with friendly creature within 5 ft. of it. Friendly creature becomes target of the attack instead.

traits.name: Aura of Courage and Protection
traits.description: If conscious friendly creatures within 10 ft. of it immune to frightened and advantage on all saves.

traits.name: Divine Weapons
traits.description: Its weapon attacks are magical. When commander hits with any weapon weapon deals extra 3d8 necrotic or radiant (included below) commander’s choice.

reactions.name: Bolster Soldier
reactions.description: When a friendly creature the field commander can see is hit with weapon attack the commander calls out encouragement and creature gains 5 (1d10) temp hp.

traits.name: Armor of Foresight
traits.description: While it is wearing no armor and wielding no shield its AC includes its Dex and Wis modifiers (included above).

traits.name: Divine Weapons
traits.description: Its weapon attacks are magical. When it hits with any weapon deals extra 3d8 necrotic or radiant (included below) servant’s choice.

bonusActions.name: Healing Hands
bonusActions.description: Touches a creature within 5 ft. of it: creature regains 14 (4d6) hp.

traits.name: Ritual Cleansing
traits.description: The fixer can take 10 min to perform a cleansing ritual on a creature object or an area within 30' that is no larger than a 20' cube. For the next 8 hrs the affected creature or object is hidden from divination magic as if it was under the effects of the nondetection spell. In an area that is ritually cleansed divination spells of 4th level or lower don’t function and creatures within the area can’t be scried.

traits.name: Burning Cold
traits.description: A creature with resistance to cold doesn’t have resistance to the cold dealt by the frost-afflicted. A creature with immunity to cold is unaffected by this trait.

traits.name: Icy Nature
traits.description: The frost-afflicted is infused with minor elemental power and it requires only half the amount of food and drink that a typical humanoid of its size needs.

reactions.name: Frigid Flare
reactions.description: When a creature hits the frost-afflicted with weapon attack ice bursts from the frost-afflicted. Each creature within 5 ft. of the frost-afflicted must make a DC 13 Con save taking 5 (2d4) cold on a failed save or half damage if made.

traits.name: Evasion
traits.description: If subject to effect that allows Dex save for half damage takes no damage on success and only half if it fails.

traits.name: Parasite Sense
traits.description: Advantage on attacks vs. poisoned creatures.

traits.name: Plant-Powered Mobility
traits.description: Opportunity attacks made vs. duelist have disadvantage. If the duelist is prone at the start of its turn it can immediately stand with o costing movement.

reactions.name: Spore Cloud
reactions.description: When it takes damage from a ranged attack emits a burst of thick yellow spores that surround infested duelist and heavily obscure area within 5 ft. of it. Spores dissipate at start of duelist's next turn.

traits.name: Knowledge Charm
traits.description: Carries a minor magical charm gifted to it by the organization. While wearing or carrying the charm infiltrator has proficiency in any two skills and is fluent in any one language (not included above). This proficiency and fluency last until charm is lost or destroyed or until infiltrator performs a 10-minute ritual to change the proficiency and fluency provided by the charm. If infiltrator dies charm becomes nonmagical.

bonusActions.name: Cunning Action
bonusActions.description: Takes the Dash Disengage or Hide action.

reactions.name: Inspiration
reactions.description: When a creature within 30' of the merchant captain fails an attack roll ability check or save the captain can force it to reroll the die. The target must use the new roll.

traits.name: Elemental Weapons
traits.description: When it hits with any weapon deals extra 3d6 acid cold fire lightning or thunder (included below) warlock’s choice.

reactions.name: Genie Lord's Favor
reactions.description: When it takes acid cold fire lightning or thunder warlock has advantage on next Elemental Burst attack it makes before end of its next turn provided Elemental Burst deals same damage as damage warlock took.

monster:tob3:npc-wind-acolyte.speed: 30 ft., Climb 15 ft., Fly 50 ft., Swim 15 ft.

traits.name: Air Senses
traits.description: Can’t use blindsight underwater or in an area with o air.

traits.name: Air Weapons
traits.description: When it attacks it conjures a weapon out of the air itself weapon appearing and disappearing in the blink of an eye. Air weapon is a swirl of wind in the shape of a simple or martial weapon but always deals 2d6 damage of the same type as that weapon. Air weapon shaped like a ranged weapon uses the range of that weapon except acolyte doesn’t have disadvantage on ranged attack rolls when attacking a target beyond weapon’s normal range. Air weapons don’t use any other weapon properties of weapons they mimic. Air weapon attacks are magical.

reactions.name: Buoying Wind
reactions.description: Summons winds to break the fall of up to 5 falling creatures it can see within 60' of it. A falling creature's rate of descent slows to 60' per round for 1 min. If a falling creature lands before effect ends it takes no falling damage and can land on its feet.

reactions.name: Drift
reactions.description: When a creature moves to within 15 ft. of the wind acolyte the acolyte can fly up to half its flying speed.

traits.name: Limited Magic Immunity
traits.description: At the end of its turn any spell or magical effect with duration that is affecting the nullicorn such as hold monster or mage armor immediately ends.

traits.name: Magic Evasion
traits.description: If it is subjected to a spell or magical effect that allows it to make a save to take only half damage it instead takes no damage if it makes the save and only half damage if it fails.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.description: Advantage: spell/magic effect saves.

traits.name: Nullifying Blight
traits.description: A creature infected with this disease manifests symptoms 1d4 hrs after infection: fatigue light-headedness and blurry vision. When infected creature casts a spell or activates a magic item itchy rash appears and spreads as more magic is used. Until disease is cured when infected creature starts its turn wielding or wearing magic item and each time it casts a spell or activates a magic item it loses 5 (2d4) hp. At end of each long rest infected creature must make a DC 13 Con save. Fail: hp the creature loses each time it uses magic increases by 2 (1d4). A creature that makes 3 saves recovers.

traits.name: Sense Magic
traits.description: Senses magic within 120' of it at will. This trait otherwise works like the detect magic spell but isn’t itself magical.

monster:tob2:nyctli.speed: 10 ft., Climb 5 ft., Fly 40 ft. (hover), Swim 5 ft.

actions.name: Stingers
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. Hit: 1 piercing damage plus 3 (1d6) necrotic damage, and the target must succeed on a DC 11 Constitution saving throw or be blinded until the end of its next turn.

actions.name: Douse Light
actions.description: The nyctli magically dispels or douses a single magical or nonmagical light source within 30 feet of it. The nyctli can't dispel light created by a spell of 3rd level or higher.

monster:tob2:nyctli-swarm.speed: 10 ft., Climb 5 ft., Fly 40 ft. (hover), Swim 5 ft.
monster:tob2:nyctli-swarm.conditionImmunities: charmed, frightened, grappled, paralyzed, petrified, prone, restrained, stunned

traits.name: Innate Spellcasting (1/Day)
traits.description: The nyctli swarm can innately cast fear, requiring no material components. Its innate spellcasting ability is Charisma.

traits.name: Swarm
traits.description: The swarm can occupy another creature’s space and vice versa, and the swarm can move through any opening large enough for a Tiny nyctli. The swarm can’t regain hp or gain temporary hp.

actions.name: Stingers
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +8 to hit, reach 0 ft., one target in the swarm's space. Hit: 21 (6d6) piercing damage, or 10 (3d6) piercing damage if the swarm has half of its hp or fewer. The target must make a DC 16 Constitution saving throw. On a failure, a creature takes 42 (12d6) necrotic damage and is blinded for 1 minute. On a success, a creature takes half the damage and isn't blinded. A creature can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.

actions.name: Douse Light
actions.description: As the nyctli, except the swarm can't dispel light created by a spell of 6th level or higher.

traits.name: False Appearance
traits.description: While motionless indistinguishable from ordinary oak tree.

traits.name: Grasping Branches
traits.description: Can have up to six Grasping Branches at a time. Each Grasping Branch can be attacked (AC 16; 25 hp; vulnerability to lightning; immunity to poison and psychic). Destroying a Grasping Branch deals no damage to the oaken sentinel which can extend a replacement branch on its next turn. A Grasping Branch can also be broken if a creature takes an action and succeeds on a DC 16 Str check vs. it.

monster:tob2:oasis-keeper.senses: blindsight 20 ft., darkvision 60 ft., passive Perception 15
monster:tob2:oasis-keeper.damageResistances: bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing from nonmagical attacks

traits.name: Hold Breath
traits.description: The oasis keeper can hold its breath for 30 minutes.

traits.name: Oasis Camouflage
traits.description: The oasis keeper has advantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks made while in a desert or in sandy terrain beneath water.

traits.name: Pacifying Secretions
traits.description: If the oasis keeper’s stinger sits in water for at least 1 hour, the water becomes poisoned with its toxin. A creature that drinks the poisoned water must succeed on a DC 15 Constitution saving throw or be calmed for 24 hours. A calmed creature feels compelled to stay at the oasis and has disadvantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks to notice or recognize danger. A calmed creature that drinks the water again before 24 hours have passed has disadvantage on the saving throw. The greater restoration spell or similar magic ends the calming effect early.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The oasis keeper makes two attacks: one with its stinger and one with its bite

actions.name: Bite
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +9 to hit, reach 10 ft, one target. Hit: 21 (3d10 + 5) piercing damage.

actions.name: Stinger
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +9 to hit, reach 10 ft, one target. Hit: 14 (2d8 + 5) piercing damage, and the target must make a DC 15 Constitution saving throw. On a failure, the target takes 14 (4d6) poison damage and is incapacitated for 1 minute. On a success, the target takes half the damage and isn't incapacitated. The target can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.

monster:tob3:obeleric.speed: 30 ft., Burrow 15 ft., Climb 15 ft., Swim 15 ft.
monster:tob3:obeleric.languages: understands Common and Void Speech but can't speak

traits.name: False Appearance
traits.description: While motionless indistinguishable from normal boulder.

traits.name: Ricochet Charge (Defensive Form Only)
traits.description: If it moves 15 ft.+ straight to target and then hits target with Boulder Bash attack on same turn target has disadvantage on save vs. being knocked prone. If target is prone obeleric can move up to 15 ft. straight to 2nd target with o provoking opportunity attacks from 1st target and make one Boulder Bash attack vs. 2nd target as a bonus action if 2nd target is within its reach.

bonusActions.name: Defensive Roll
bonusActions.description: Can roll itself into a boulder-like defensive form or back into its tentacled true form. While in defensive form it has resistance to B/P/S damage from nonmagical attacks can't make Tentacle Slam or Spit Acid attacks and can't use Reflux.

reactions.name: Reflux
reactions.description: When the obeleric takes bludgeoning it can vomit acid at one creature within 5 ft. of it. That creature must make DC 13 Dex save or take 3 (1d6) acid.

monster:tob3:obsidian-ophidian.conditionImmunities: exhaustion, paralyzed, petrified, poisoned, prone, unconscious

traits.name: Lava Walker
traits.description: Can move across lava surface as if harmless solid ground. In addition can swim through lava at its walk speed.

traits.name: One with Lava
traits.description: Can’t be surprised by creatures within 5 ft. of lava and  can sense any creature touching same pool of lava it is touching.

traits.name: Sharp Fragments
traits.description: When it takes bludgeoning each creature within 5 ft. of it takes 2 (1d4) piercing damage as shards of obsidian fly from it.

traits.name: Volcanic Rejuvenation
traits.description: Regains 10 hp at the start of its turn if at least part of its body is in contact with lava. If it takes cold dmage this doesn't function at the start of its next turn. Dies only if it starts its turn with 0 hp and doesn’t regenerate.

monster:a5e-mm:ochre-jelly.conditionImmunities: blinded, charmed, deafened, fatigue, frightened, prone

traits.name: Amorphous
traits.description: The jelly can pass through an opening as narrow as 1 inch wide without squeezing.

traits.name: Ooze Nature
traits.description: An ooze doesnt require air or sleep.

traits.name: Spider Climb
traits.description: The jelly can use its climb speed even on difficult surfaces and upside down on ceilings.

traits.name: Sunlight Sensitivity
traits.description: While in sunlight, the jelly has disadvantage on attack rolls.

actions.name: Pseudopod
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 9 (2d6 + 2) bludgeoning damage plus 3 (1d6) acid damage  and the target is grappled (escape DC 12). A grappled target takes 3 (1d6) acid damage at the start of each of the jellys turns.

reactions.name: Split
reactions.description: When a Medium or larger jelly with at least 10 hit points is subjected to lightning or slashing damage, it splits into two jellies that are each one size smaller, freeing any grappled targets. Each new jelly has half the originals hit points (rounded down).

monster:bfrd:ochre-jelly.damageImmunities: lightning, slashing, grappled, poisoned, Ooze Resilience

traits.name: Amorphous
traits.description: The ochre jelly can move through a space as narrow as 1 inch wide without squeezing.

traits.name: Ooze Nature
traits.description: The ochre jelly doesn't require sleep.

traits.name: Ooze Resilience
traits.description: The ochre jelly is resistant to the restrained condition, and it is immune to exhaustion and to the blinded, charmed, deafened, frightened, and prone conditions.

traits.name: Overwhelming Stench
traits.description: A creature that starts its turn within 10 feet of the ochre jelly must succeed on a DC 13 CON save or be poisoned until the start of its next turn. If a creature fails the save by 5 or more, it must spend its turn retching uncontrollably and be unable to move or act.

traits.name: Spider Climb
traits.description: The ochre jelly can climb difficult surfaces, including upside down on ceilings, without needing to make an ability check.

actions.name: Pseudopod
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 10 (2d6+3) bludgeoning damage plus 7 (2d6) acid damage. If the target is poisoned, it must succeed on a DC 13 CON save or also take 5 (2d4) poison damage.

reactions.name: Split
reactions.description: When an ochre jelly that is Medium or larger is subjected to lightning or slashing damage, it splits into two new ochre jellies if it has at least 10 HP. Each new jelly has HP equal to half the original jelly's, rounded down. New jellies are one size smaller than the original jelly.

traits.name: Camouflage
traits.description: The octopus has advantage on Stealth checks.

traits.name: Water Breathing
traits.description: The octopus breathes water and can hold its breath for 30 minutes while in air.

actions.name: Tentacles
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. Hit: 1 bludgeoning damage. If the target is a creature  it is grappled (escape DC 10). Until this grapple ends  the target is restrained  and the octopus can't attack a different target with its tentacles.

bonusActions.name: Ink Cloud
bonusActions.description: If underwater, the octopus exudes a cloud of ink in a 5-foot-radius sphere, extending around corners. The area is heavily obscured for 1 minute unless dispersed by a strong current.

traits.name: Hold Breath
traits.description: While out of water, the octopus can hold its breath for 30 minutes.

traits.name: Underwater Camouflage
traits.description: The octopus's Stealth is 18 while underwater.

traits.name: Water Breathing
traits.description: The octopus can breathe only underwater.

actions.name: Tentacles
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +3 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 3 (1d4+1) bludgeoning damage, and the target is grappled (escape DC 11), if it is a Medium or smaller creature. Until this grapple ends, the octopus can't use its Tentacles on another target.

reactions.name: Ink Dash
reactions.description: When a creature the octopus can see deals damage to it, the octopus can release a 5-foot-radius cloud of ink all around itself, if it is underwater. The area is heavily obscured until the end of the octopus's next turn, although a significant current can disperse the ink. Then, the octopus can swim up to its swimming speed. If it does so, it immediately releases any creature it is grappling.

traits.name: Hold Breath
traits.description: While out of water, the octopus can hold its breath for 1 hour.

traits.name: Underwater Camouflage
traits.description: The octopus's Stealth is 18 while underwater.

traits.name: Water Breathing
traits.description: The octopus can breathe only underwater.

actions.name: Tentacles
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. Hit: 10 (2d6+3) bludgeoning damage, and the target is grappled (escape DC 13), if it is a Huge or smaller creature. Until this grapple ends, the target is restrained. The octopus can grapple up to two creatures at one time.

bonusActions.name: Tentacle Slam
bonusActions.description: The octopus slams a Medium or smaller creature it is grappling into a solid surface. The target must make a DC 13 STR save, taking 7 (2d6) bludgeoning damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

reactions.name: Ink Dash
reactions.description: When a creature the octopus can see deals damage to it, the octopus can release a 20-foot- radius cloud of ink all around itself, if it is underwater. The area is heavily obscured until the end of the octopus's next turn, although a significant current can disperse the ink. Then, the octopus can swim up to its swimming speed. If it does so, it immediately releases any creatures it is grappling.

monster:tob:oculo-swarm.speed: 5 ft., Climb 2 ft., Fly 40 ft. (hover), Swim 2 ft.
monster:tob:oculo-swarm.conditionImmunities: charmed, frightened, paralyzed, petrified, prone, restrained, stunned

traits.name: Swarm
traits.description: The swarm can occupy another creature's space and vice versa, and the swarm can move through any opening at least 2 inches square. The swarm can't regain hit points or gain temporary hit points.

actions.name: Eye Extraction
actions.description: Every creature that occupies the same space as the swarm must succeed on a DC 13 Constitution saving throw or become temporarily blinded as their eyes strain from their sockets. This blindness lasts for as long as the affected creature remains in the same space as the oculus; it ends at the end of the blinded creature's turn if the creature is out of the oculus's space. Also, any cure spell cast on the blinded creature ends the temporary blindness, but not restoration spells. If a creature that's already temporarily blinded is targeted again by eye extraction and fails the saving throw, that creature becomes permanently blind as its eyes are pulled from their sockets to join the swarm (causing 1d8 piercing damage). Success on either saving throw renders that creature immune to eye extraction for 24 hours (but it still doesn't recover its sight until it gets out of the swarm). An oculo swarm with 50 or fewer hit points can't use this ability.

actions.name: Gaze
actions.description: The swarm targets every creature in its space with a gaze attack. The swarm can choose one of two effects for the attack: confusion or hold person. Every target in the swarm's space is affected unless it makes a successful DC 14 Charisma saving throw. Even creatures that avert their eyes or are blind can be affected by an oculus swarm's gaze. The confusion or hold person effect lasts 1d4 rounds.

monster:tob-2023:oculo-swarm.speed: 40 ft., Climb 20 ft., Fly 5 ft., Swim 20 ft.
monster:tob-2023:oculo-swarm.conditionImmunities: charmed, frightened, grappled, paralyzed, petrified, prone, restrained, stunned

traits.name: Hundreds of Eyes
traits.description: The oculo swarm has advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on sight and on saving throws against being blinded. In addition, if the swarm isn’t blinded, creatures attacking it can’t benefit from traits and features that rely on a creature’s allies distracting or surrounding the swarm, such as the Pack Tactics trait or Sneak Attack class feature.

traits.name: Swarm
traits.description: The swarm can occupy another creature’s space and vice versa, and the swarm can move through any opening large enough for a Tiny eyeball. The swarm can’t regain hp or gain temporary hp.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The oculo swarm makes two Extract Eye attacks. If both attacks hit one creature, the target must succeed on a DC 13 Strength saving throw or the swarm removes one of its eyes. While missing half or fewer of its total number of eyes, the target has disadvantage on attack rolls and Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on sight. While missing more than half its total number of eyes, the target is blinded until its sight is restored. If the target's eye is recovered from the defeated swarm, it can be reattached with a successful DC 12 Wisdom (Medicine) check, provided the eye is reattached within 1 hour of the target losing the eye.

actions.name: Extract Eye
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 0 ft., one creature in the swarm's space. Hit: 18 (4d8) piercing damage, or 9 (2d8) piercing damage if the swarm has half of its hp or fewer.

actions.name: Disorienting Gaze
actions.description: The swarm's many eyes suddenly turn in different directions. Each creature within 10 feet of the oculo swarm must make a DC 13 Charisma saving throw. On a failure, a creature takes 21 (6d6) psychic damage and is disoriented until the end of its next turn. On a success, a creature takes half the damage and isn't disoriented. A disoriented creature is incapacitated and moves in a random direction when it moves.

monster:tob3:offal-walker.languages: understands the languages of its creator but can't speak

traits.name: Gut Lassos
traits.description: Can have up to three gut lassos at a time. Each gut lasso can be attacked (AC 13; 5 hp; immunity to poison). Destroying a lasso deals no damage to the offal walker which can extrude a replacement gut lasso on its next turn. A gut lasso can also be broken if a creature takes an action and succeeds on a DC 13 Str check vs. it.

traits.name: Undead Nature
traits.description: Doesn't require air food drink or sleep.

actions.name: Greatclub
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 13 (2d8 + 4) bludgeoning damage  and if the target is a Medium or smaller creature  it makes a DC 14 Strength saving throw  falling prone on a failure.

actions.name: Sweeping Strike
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 5 ft.  all creatures within 5 feet. Hit: 8 (1d8 + 4) bludgeoning damage  and if the target is a Medium or smaller creature  it makes a DC 14 Strength saving throw. On a failure  it is pushed 10 feet away from the ogre.

actions.name: Javelin
actions.description: Melee or Ranged Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 30/120 ft., one target. Hit: 11 (2d6 + 4) piercing damage.

traits.name: Giant Attributes
traits.description: The ogre is resistant to the stunned condition, and it is vulnerable to the prone condition.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The ogre makes two Greatclub or Javelin attacks.

actions.name: Greatclub
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 13 (2d8+4) bludgeoning damage.

actions.name: Javelin
actions.description: Melee or Ranged Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 30/120 ft., one target. Hit: 11 (2d6+4) piercing damage.

actions.name: Bowling Sweep
actions.description: The ogre sweeps its weapon in a wide arc around it. Each creature within 10 feet of the ogre must make a DC 14 STR save. Small and smaller creatures have disadvantage on the save. On a failure, a creature takes 14 (4d6) bludgeoning damage, is pushed up to 10 feet away from the ogre, and is knocked prone. On a success, a creature takes half the damage and isn't pushed or knocked prone.

bonusActions.name: Shoving Rush
bonusActions.description: The ogre takes the Dash action. If it moves, it can propel itself into one creature it can see along its path. The target must succeed on a DC 14 STR save or be knocked prone. This movement doesn't provoke opportunity attacks from a target that fails this save.

traits.name: Aggressive
traits.description: As a bonus action, the corrupted ogre chieftain can move up to its speed toward a hostile creature that it can see. Mutation. The corrupted ogre chieftain has one mutation from the list below:

traits.name: Mutation
traits.description:
1 - Armored Hide: The corrupted ogre chieftain's skin is covered in dull, melted scales that give it resistance to bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage from nonmagical attacks.

2 - Extra Arm: The corrupted ogre chieftain has a third arm growing from its chest. The corrupted ogre chieftain can make three melee attacks or two ranged attacks.

3 - Savant: The corrupted ogre chieftain's head is grossly enlarged. Increase its Charisma to 16. The corrupted ogre chieftain gains Innate Spellcasting (Psionics), and its innate spellcasting ability is Charisma (spell save DC 14). It can innately cast the following spells, requiring no components: At will: misty step, shield; 1/day each: dominate monster, levitate.

4 - Terrifying: The corrupted ogre chieftain's body is covered in horns, eyes, and fanged maws. Each creature of the corrupted ogre chieftain's choice that is within 60 feet of it and is aware of it must succeed on a DC 15 Wisdom saving throw or become frightened for 1 minute. A frightened creature repeats the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success. If a creature's saving throw is successful or the effect ends for it, the creature is immune to this ogre chieftain's Frightful Presence for the next 24 hours.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The corrupted ogre chieftain makes two melee attacks.

actions.name: Greatclub
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +8 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 14 (2d8 + 5) bludgeoning damage.

actions.name: Javelin
actions.description: Melee or Ranged Weapon Attack: +8 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 30/120 ft., one target. Hit: 12 (2d6 + 5) piercing damage.

traits.name: Undead Fortitude (1/Day)
traits.description: If the zombie is reduced to 0 hit points by damage that isnt radiant or from a critical hit, its instead reduced to 1 hit point, falls prone, and is stunned until the end of its next turn, appearing to be dead.

traits.name: Undead Nature
traits.description: A zombie doesnt require air, sustenance, or sleep.

actions.name: Grab
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 11 (2d6 + 4) bludgeoning damage  and the target is grappled if its Medium or smaller (escape DC 14)  and until the grapple ends  the zombie can't grab another target.

actions.name: Bite
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target grappled by a zombie. Hit: 15 (2d10 + 4) piercing damage  and the zombie regains hit points equal to the damage dealt

reactions.name: Bodyblock
reactions.description: If the ogre flesh heap is grappling a creature when it is hit with a weapon attack by a creature it can see, it uses the creature as a shield, adding 2 to its AC against the attack. If this causes the attack to miss, the attack hits the grappled creature instead.

reactions.name: Corpulent Expulsion
reactions.description: When it takes damage, the ogre flesh heaps belly splits and releases a torrent of caustic gore in a 30-foot cone. Creatures in this area make a DC 14 Dexterity saving throw, taking 14 (4d6) acid damage on a failure and half damage on a success. The flesh heap then takes 10 (3d6) acid damage.

monster:a5e-mm:ogre-mage.speed: 30 ft., Climb 15 ft., Fly 30 ft., Swim 15 ft.

traits.name: Innate Spellcasting
traits.description:
The ogres innate spellcasting ability is Charisma (spell save DC 14). It can innately cast the following spells, requiring no material components:

- At Will: Darkness, Invisibility
- 1/Day:  Charm Person, Cone of Cold, Gaseous Form, Hold Person

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The ogre makes two melee attacks.

actions.name: Claw
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 11 (2d6 + 4) slashing damage.

actions.name: Iron Club
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 17 (2d12 + 4) bludgeoning damage  or 10 (1d12 + 4) bludgeoning damage in Small or Medium form. When the ogre hits or touches a target with its club  it can end any spell on the target that was cast with a 3rd-level or lower spell slot.

actions.name: Read Scroll
actions.description: The ogre casts a spell from a magical scroll without expending the scrolls magic.

actions.name: Darkness
actions.description: (2nd-Level; V, S, Concentration) Magical darkness spreads from a point within 30 feet of the ogre  filling a 15-foot-radius sphere and spreading around corners. It remains for 1 minute. A creature with darkvision can't see through this darkness  and nonmagical light can't illuminate it.

actions.name: Hold Person
actions.description: (2nd-Level; V, S, Concentration) One humanoid the ogre can see within 60 feet makes a DC 14 Wisdom saving throw. On a failure  the target is paralyzed for 1 minute  repeating the saving throw at the end of each of its turns  ending the effect on a success.

actions.name: Invisibility
actions.description: (2nd-Level; V, S, Concentration) The ogre is invisible for 1 hour. The spell ends if the ogre attacks or casts a spell.

actions.name: Gaseous Form
actions.description: (3rd-Level; V, S, Concentration) The ogre and its gear becomes a hovering cloud of gas for 1 hour. Its Speed is 0  and its fly speed is 30. It can't attack  use or drop objects  talk  or cast spells. It can enter another creatures space and pass through small holes and cracks but can't pass through liquid. It is resistant to nonmagical damage  has advantage on Strength  Dexterity and Constitution saving throws  and can't fall.

actions.name: Cone of Cold
actions.description: (5th-Level; V, S) Frost blasts from the ogre in a 60-foot cone. Each creature in the area makes a DC 14 Constitution saving throw  taking 36 (8d8) cold damage on a failure or half damage on a success.

bonusActions.name: Shapeshift
bonusActions.description: The ogre changes its form into a Small or Medium humanoid, or back into its true form, which is a Large giant. Other than its size, its statistics are the same in each form. Its iron club, armor, and clothing change size with it. It reverts to its true form when it dies.

monster:bfrd:ogre-zombie.languages: understands Common and Giant but can't speak

traits.name: Undead Fortitude
traits.description: If damage reduces the zombie to 0 HP, it must make a CON save with a DC equal to 5 + the damage taken, unless the damage is radiant or from a critical hit. On a success, the zombie drops to 1 HP instead.

traits.name: Undead Nature
traits.description: The zombie doesn't require air, food, drink, or sleep.

traits.name: Undead Resilience
traits.description: The zombie is immune to poison damage, to exhaustion, and to the poisoned condition.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The ogre zombie makes two Greatclub attacks.

actions.name: Greatclub
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 13 (2d8+4) bludgeoning damage.

actions.name: Lumbering Charge
actions.description: The ogre zombie shoulders its weapon and charges forward, shoving into creatures on its way. It moves up to 20 feet in a straight line and can move through the space of any Medium or smaller creature. The first time it enters a creature's space during this move, that creature must make a DC 14 STR save. On a failure, a creature takes 14 (4d6) bludgeoning damage and is knocked prone. On a success, a creature takes half the damage and isn't knocked prone.

traits.name: I Work for the Boss (3/Day)
traits.description: If subjected to an effect that would force it to make an Int Wis or Cha save while it is within 30' of its superior can use the superior’s Int Wis or Cha modifier for the save instead of its own.

traits.name: Imposing Figure
traits.description: Uses its Str modifier instead of its Cha when making Intimidation checks (included above).

reactions.name: Intimidating Rebuff
reactions.description: When a creature the alleybasher can see within 30' of it targets it with an attack ogre can make a Str (Intimidation) check taking half a step forward snarling or otherwise spooking the attacker. If check is equal to or higher than attack roll attacker must reroll the attack using lower of the two results.

traits.name: Infernal Runes
traits.description: Its tattoos give it a +2 bonus to its AC (included above). In addition the ogre has advantage on saves vs. spells and other magical effects.

traits.name: Unholy Blade
traits.description: Infused with unholy power the ogre’s weapon attacks are magical. When it hits with any weapon weapon deals an extra 2d6 necrotic (included below).

reactions.name: Gauntleted Backhand
reactions.description: When a creature within 5 ft. of the ogre misses the ogre with melee attack the attacker must make DC 16 Dex save or be knocked prone

traits.name: Arcane Weapons
traits.description: Its weapon attacks are magical. When it hits with any weapon deals an extra 1d8 force (included below).

traits.name: Artisan’s Prowess
traits.description: If a magic item requires an action to activate ogre can activate it as a bonus action instead.

traits.name: Sense Magic
traits.description: Senses magic within 120' of it at will. Otherwise works like the detect magic spell but isn’t itself magical.

traits.name: Scent of Death
traits.description: Any creature that isn’t Undead and that starts its turn within 5 ft. of the kadag ogre: poisoned until the start of its next turn (DC 15 Con negates and target immune to the kadag ogre’s Scent of Death for 1 hr).

traits.name: Undead Affinity
traits.description: An Undead has disadvantage on attack rolls vs. the kadag ogre if the ogre hasn’t attacked that Undead within the past 24 hrs. In addition each skeleton and zombie within 30' of the kadag ogre that has no master follows ogre’s verbal commands until a master asserts magical control over it.

traits.name: Devouring Charge (Boar Form Only)
traits.description: If it moves at least 20' straight toward a target and then hits it with Tusk attack on the same turn the target must make DC 14 Str save or be knocked prone. If the target is prone the ogre can make one Bite attack vs. it as a bonus action.

traits.name: Fey Ancestry
traits.description: Advantage: saves vs. charmed; Immune: magic sleep.

traits.name: Speak with Beasts
traits.description: Can communicate with Beasts as if they shared a language.

bonusActions.name: Change Shape
bonusActions.description: Transforms into a Large boar or back into its true ogre form. Its stats are the same in each form. Any equipment it is wearing or carrying isn't transformed. Reverts on death.

traits.name: Stone Chomper
traits.description: The rockchewer ogre deals double damage to stone objects and structures with its bite attack.

bonusActions.name: Quick Chew
bonusActions.description: Uses Chew Rock.

reactions.name: Rock Catching
reactions.description: If a rock or similar object is hurled at the rockchewer ogre the ogre can with successful DC 10 Dex save catch the missile and take no bludgeoning from it.

monster:tob3:ogre-void-blessed.senses: blindsight 30 ft., tremorsense 120 ft., passive Perception 16

traits.name: Keen Hearing and Smell
traits.description: Advantage on Wis (Perception) checks that rely on hearing or smell.

traits.name: Tentacle Senses
traits.description: Can’t use its tremorsense while grappled or restrained.

reactions.name: Volatile Stomach
reactions.description: When it takes bludgeoning piercing or slashing can regurgitate some of its stomach contents. Each creature within 5 ft. of it: 4 (1d8) necrotic and be poisoned until end of its next turn (DC 15 Con negates). A pool of Void infused stomach contents forms in a space ogre can see within 5 ft. of it and lasts until start of ogre's next turn. A creature that enters pool for first time on a turn or starts its turn there: 4 (1d8) necrotic.

traits.name: Giant Build
traits.description: The ogrekin counts as one size larger when determining carrying capacity and the weight it can push, drag, or lift. Its melee and thrown weapons deal an extra die of damage on a hit (included below).

actions.name: Battleaxe
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 12 (2d8 + 3) slashing damage.

actions.name: Handaxe
actions.description: Melee or Ranged Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft., one target. Hit: 10 (2d6 + 3) slashing damage.

monster:tob2:ogrepede.languages: understands all languages it knew in life but can't speak

traits.name: Haphazard Charge
traits.description: If the ogrepede moves at least 10 feet straight toward a creature and then hits it with a slam attack on the same turn, the attack is treated as though the ogrepede scored a critical hit, but attack rolls against the ogrepede have advantage until the start of its next turn.

traits.name: Overwhelming Assault
traits.description: When the ogrepede scores a critical hit, each creature within 5 feet of the target must succeed on a DC 16 Wisdom saving throw or be frightened of the ogrepede for 1 minute. A creature can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success. If a creature’s saving throw is successful or the effect ends for it, the creature is immune to the ogrepede’s Overwhelming Assault for the next 24 hours.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The ogrepede makes two attacks: one with its bite and one with its slam.

actions.name: Bite
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +8 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. Hit: 16 (2d10 + 5) piercing damage.

actions.name: Slam
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +8 to hit, reach 10 ft., one creature. Hit: 12 (2d6 + 5) bludgeoning damage, or 8 (1d6 + 5) bludgeoning damage if the ogrepede has half its hp or fewer. If the ogrepede scores a critical hit, it rolls the damage dice three times, instead of twice.

monster:tob3:old-salt.languages: the languages it knew in life

traits.name: Experienced Sailor
traits.description: Advantage on Str (Athletics) checks made to climb while on a sailing ship and on Dex (Acrobatics) checks to maintain its footing while on a sailing ship.

traits.name: Seaside Rejuvenation
traits.description: If at least one of its accusers is still alive or if its name hasn’t been cleared destroyed old salt gains new body in 13 days regaining all hp and becoming active again. New body appears on beach or dock nearest one of its living accusers.

traits.name: Undead Nature
traits.description: Doesn't require air food drink or sleep.

bonusActions.name: Cunning Action
bonusActions.description: Take Dash Disengage or Hide.

traits.name: Trampling Charge
traits.description: If the oliphaunt moves at least 20 feet straight toward a creature and then hits it with a gore attack on the same turn, that target must succeed on a DC 16 Strength saving throw or be knocked prone. If the target is prone, the oliphaunt can make one stomp attack against it as a bonus action.

traits.name: Trunk Slam
traits.description: If the oliphaunt starts its turn with a target grappled, it can slam the target into the ground as a bonus action. The creature must make a DC 17 Constitution saving throw, taking 11 (2d10) bludgeoning damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. This doesn't end the grappled condition on the target.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The oliphaunt uses its trunk, then it makes one gore or stomp attack.

actions.name: Gore
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +11 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 30 (5d8 + 8) piercing damage.

actions.name: Stomp
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +11 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 35 (5d10 + 8) bludgeoning damage.

actions.name: Trunk
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +11 to hit, reach 15 ft., one creature. Hit: The target is grappled (escape DC 17) if it is a Large or smaller creature. Until the grapple ends, the target is restrained and the oliphaunt can't use its trunk on another target.

actions.name: Tusk Sweep
actions.description: The oliphaunt sweeps its tusks in a wide arc. Each creature in a 20-foot cube must make a DC 17 Dexterity saving throw, taking 35 (10d6) bludgeoning damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

monster:ccdx:one-headed-clockwork-dragon.speed: 30 ft., Climb 15 ft., Fly 50 ft., Swim 15 ft.
monster:ccdx:one-headed-clockwork-dragon.conditionImmunities: charmed, exhaustion, frightened, paralyzed, petrified, poisoned

traits.name: Bound
traits.description:
The dragon is magically bound to three circlets. As long as the dragon is within 1 mile of a circlet wearer on the same plane of existence, the wearer can communicate telepathically with the dragon. While the dragon is active, the wearers see through its eyes and hear what it hears. During this time, the wearers are deaf and blind with regard to their own senses.

If only two circlet wearers are within 1 mile of the active dragon, each hour spent wearing the circlets imposes one level of exhaustion on those wearers. If only a single wearer is within 1 mile of the active dragon, each minute spent wearing the circlet gives that wearer one level of exhaustion. If no circlet wearers are within 1 mile of the dragon, it views all creatures it can see as enemies and tries to destroy them until a circlet wearer communicates with the dragon or the dragon is destroyed. A circlet wearer can use its action to put the dragon in an inactive state where it becomes incapacitated until a wearer uses an action to switch the dragon to active.

Each circlet is a magic item that must be attuned.

traits.name: Immutable Form
traits.description: The dragon is immune to any spell or effect that would alter its form.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.description: The dragon has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

traits.name: Siege Monster
traits.description: The dragon deals double damage to objects and structures.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The dragon can use its Oil Spray. It then makes three attacks: one with its bite and two with its fists.

actions.name: Bite
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +9 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 17 (2d10 + 6) piercing damage plus 3 (1d6) fire damage.

actions.name: Fist
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +9 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 13 (2d6 + 6) bludgeoning damage.

actions.name: Fire Breath
actions.description: The dragon exhales fire in a 30-foot cone. Each creature in that area must make a DC 16 Dexterity saving throw, taking 35 (10d6) fire damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

actions.name: Oil Spray
actions.description: The dragon sprays oil in a 30-foot-cone. Each creature in the area must succeed on a DC 16 Dexterity saving throw or become vulnerable to fire damage until the end of the dragon's next turn.

actions.name: Tail Sweep
actions.description: The dragon swings its bladed tail. Each creature within 10 feet of the dragon must make a DC 17 Dexterity saving throw, taking 15 (2d8 + 6) slashing damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

traits.name: Innate Spellcasting
traits.description:
The one-horned ogre’s innate spellcasting ability is Charisma (spell save DC 15). It can innately cast the following spells, requiring no material components.
2/day each: darkness, misty step, suggestion
1/day each: fear

traits.name: Magical Horn
traits.description: The power of the one-horned ogre comes from its horn. If the horn is ever removed, the one-horned ogre loses its Fiendish Horn Blast action and its Innate Spellcasting trait, and its Charisma score is reduced to 8 (-1). If the ogre receives a new horn through regenerative magic or a blessing from its patron, it regains what it lost.

traits.name: Ruthless Weapons
traits.description: When the one-horned ogre hits a blinded, charmed, or frightened creature with any weapon, the weapon deals an extra 1d6 psychic damage.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The one-horned ogre can use its Fiendish Horn Blast. It then makes one greatsword attack.

actions.name: Greatsword
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +8 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 19 (4d6 + 5) slashing damage.

actions.name: Javelin
actions.description: Melee or Ranged Weapon Attack: +8 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 30/120 ft., one target. Hit: 12 (2d6 + 5) piercing damage.

actions.name: Fiendish Horn Blast
actions.description: The one-horned ogre directs the power of its horn at a target it can see within 30 feet of it. The target must make a DC 15 Wisdom saving throw. On a failure, the target takes 10 (3d6) psychic damage and suffers a condition for 1 minute based on the color of the ogre's horn: blinded (black), charmed (crimson), or frightened (white). On a success, the target takes half the damage and doesn't suffer the condition. The target can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.

monster:bfrd:oni.speed: 30 ft., Climb 15 ft., Fly 30 ft. (hover), Swim 15 ft.

traits.name: Empowered Weapons
traits.description: The oni's weapon attacks are magical. When the oni hits with any weapon, the weapon deals an extra 3d6 force damage (included in the attack).

traits.name: Giant Attributes
traits.description: The oni is resistant to the stunned condition.

traits.name: Regeneration
traits.description: The oni regains 10 HP at the start of its turn if it has at least 1 HP.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The oni makes two Claw or Glaive attacks, or it makes three Arcane Bolt attacks. It can replace one attack with a use of Spellcasting.

actions.name: Claw
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 13 (2d8+4) slashing damage plus 10 (3d6) force damage.

actions.name: Glaive
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 15 (2d10+4) slashing damage, or 9 (1d10+4) slashing damage in a Medium or smaller form, plus 10 (3d6) force damage.

actions.name: Arcane Bolt
actions.description: Ranged Spell Attack: +6 to hit, range 60 ft., one target. Hit: 17 (4d6+3) force damage.

actions.name: Whirling Glaive
actions.description: The oni channels its magic into its twirling glaive, creating magical wind in a 30-foot cone. Each creature in the area must make a DC 14 STR save. On a failure, a creature takes 31 (9d6) cold damage and is pushed up to 15 feet away from the oni. On a success, a creature takes half the damage and isn't pushed.

actions.name: Spellcasting
actions.description:
The oni casts one of the following spells, requiring no material components and using CHA as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 14).

- At Will: darkness, invisibility (self only)
- 1/Day Each: charm, gaseous form, sleep

bonusActions.name: Change Shape
bonusActions.description: The oni magically transforms into a Small or Medium Humanoid, a Large ogre, or back into its true form, which is Giant. Its statistics, other than its size, are the same in each form. Any equipment it is wearing or carrying transforms with it, except for its glaive, which adjusts to fit its new form. If the oni dies, it reverts to its true form, and the glaive reverts to its normal size.

monster:tob2:onyx-magistrate.damageImmunities: necrotic, poison; bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing from nonmagical attacks not made with adamantine weapons
monster:tob2:onyx-magistrate.conditionImmunities: charmed, exhaustion, frightened, paralyzed, poisoned, prone

traits.name: Immutable Form
traits.description: The onyx magistrate is immune to any spell or effect that would alter its form.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.description: The onyx magistrate has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

traits.name: Magic Weapons
traits.description: The onyx magistrate’s weapon attacks are magical.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The onyx magistrate makes three scepter attacks. Alternatively, it can use Necrotic Ray twice.

actions.name: Scepter
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 15 (2d10 + 4) bludgeoning damage, and the target must succeed on a DC 15 Strength saving throw or be knocked prone.

actions.name: Necrotic Ray
actions.description: Ranged Spell Attack: +8 to hit, range 30/120 ft., one target. Hit: 17 (3d8 + 4) necrotic damage.

actions.name: Dire Judgement
actions.description: Each creature of the onyx magistrate's choice that is within 30 feet of the magistrate and aware of it must succeed on a DC 16 Wisdom saving throw or be cursed with dire judgment. While cursed in this way, the creature can't regain hp by magical means, though it can still regain hp from resting and other nonmagical means. In addition, when a cursed creature makes an attack roll or a saving throw, it must roll a d4 and subtract the number from the attack roll or saving throw. The curse lasts until it is lifted by a remove curse spell or similar magic.

reactions.name: Tip the Scales
reactions.description: The onyx magistrate adds 3 to its AC against one attack that would hit it. Alternatively, the onyx magistrate succeeds on a saving throw it failed.

monster:tob:oozasis.senses: blindsight 60 ft., tremorsense 120 ft., passive Perception 20
monster:tob:oozasis.languages: understands all languages but can't speak, telepathy 120 ft.
monster:tob:oozasis.damageResistances: fire, lightning; bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing from nonmagical attacks
monster:tob:oozasis.conditionImmunities: blinded, charmed, deafened, exhaustion, frightened, prone

traits.name: Amorphous
traits.description: The oozasis can move through a space as narrow as 1 inch wide without squeezing.

traits.name: Mirage
traits.description: As a bonus action, the oozasis can create a mirage around itself to lure victims toward it while disguising its true nature. This functions as the mirage arcane spell (save DC 16) but is nonmagical, and therefore can't be detected using detect magic or similar magic, and can't be dispelled.

traits.name: Waters of Unfathomable Compulsion
traits.description: Any creature that drinks the water of an oozasis or eats fruit from the plants growing in it has a dream (as the spell, save DC 16) the next time it sleeps. In this dream, the oozasis places a compulsion to carry out some activity as a torrent of images and sensations. When the creature awakens, it is affected by a geas spell (save DC 16, cast as a 7th-level spell) in addition to the effects of dream.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The oozasis makes two pseudopod attacks.

actions.name: Pseudopod
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +8 to hit, reach 15 ft., one creature. Hit: 13 (2d8 + 4) bludgeoning damage plus 10 (3d6) acid damage, and a target that's Large or smaller is grappled (escape DC 16) and restrained until the grapple ends. The oozasis has two pseudopods, each of which can grapple one target at a time.

actions.name: Engulf
actions.description: The oozasis engulfs creatures grappled by it. An engulfed creature can't breathe, is restrained, is no longer grappled, has total cover against attacks and other effects outside the oozasis, takes 21 (6d6) acid damage at the start of each of the oozasis's turns, and is subject to the oozasis's Waters of Unfathomable Compulsion trait. The creature takes no damage if the oozasis chooses not to inflict any. When the oozasis moves, the engulfed creature moves with it. An engulfed creature can escape by using an action and making a successful DC 16 Strength check. On a success, the creature enters a space of its choice within 5 feet of the oozasis.

actions.name: Vapors of Tranquility or Turmoil
actions.description: The oozasis sublimates its waters into a vapor that fills a disk centered on the oozasis, 60 feet in radius, and 10 feet thick. All creatures in the area are affected by either the calm emotions spell or the confusion spell (save DC 16). The oozasis chooses which effect to use, and it must be the same for all creatures.

monster:tob-2023:oozasis.speed: 20 ft., Burrow 20 ft., Climb 10 ft., Swim 10 ft.
monster:tob-2023:oozasis.languages: understands all languages but can't speak, telepathy 120 ft.
monster:tob-2023:oozasis.damageResistances: fire; bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing from nonmagical attacks
monster:tob-2023:oozasis.conditionImmunities: blinded, charmed, deafened, exhaustion, frightened, prone

traits.name: Amorphous
traits.description: The oozasis can move through a space as narrow as 1 foot wide without squeezing.

traits.name: Oasis Appearance
traits.description: While the oozasis remains motionless and partially submerged on the surface of sand or soil, it is indistinguishable from a small oasis or pond. The oozasis’s body provides enough water for plants to grow around it, provided the oozasis remains in the area for an extended period of time. A creature that eats a fruit from a plant growing in the oozasis’s water is affected by the Waters of Unfathomable Compulsion trait as if it drank the water.

traits.name: Ooze Nature
traits.description: The oozasis doesn’t require sleep.

traits.name: Waters of Unfathomable Compulsion
traits.description: A creature that drinks the water of an oozasis experiences a cryptic dream the next time it sleeps. When it wakes, it must succeed on a DC 16 Wisdom saving throw or be affected by the geas spell for 30 days. While under the geas, the affected creature must perform a specific, seemingly minor task that furthers the decades-long goals of the oozasis. Such a task could be planting a white rose in a specific garden, rescuing the next endangered young animal the target encounters, or standing in a specific spot at a certain time each day for three days.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The oozasis makes three Pseudopod attacks.

actions.name: Pseudopod
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +8 to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. Hit: 13 (2d8 + 4) bludgeoning damage plus 7 (2d6) acid damage. If the target is a Large or smaller creature, it is grappled (escape DC 16). Until this grapple ends, the target is restrained. The oozasis can have up to two creatures grappled at a time.

actions.name: Compelling Vapors
actions.description: The oozasis emits mind-altering vapors. Each creature within 20 feet of the oozasis must make a DC 16 Constitution saving throw. On a failure, a creature takes 45 (10d8) psychic damage and suffers either tranquility or turmoil for minute. On a success, a creature takes half the damage and doesn't suffer tranquility or turmoil. A creature suffering tranquility is charmed and can't attack. A creature suffering turmoil is unable to distinguish friend from foe and must move to and attack the nearest creature other than the oozasis on each of its turns, stalking off in a random direction if no creature is in range. A creature suffering tranquility or turmoil can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.

monster:tob3:ooze-leavesrot.conditionImmunities: blinded, charmed, deafened, exhaustion, frightened, prone

traits.name: Amorphous
traits.description: Move through space 1ft.+ wide with o squeezing.

traits.name: False Appearance
traits.description: While motionless indistinguishable from ordinary pile of leaves.

traits.name: Ooze Nature
traits.description: Doesn’t require sleep.

traits.name: Rotting Leaves
traits.description: When a creature hits it with melee attack while within 5 ft. of it mold spores and decomposing matter fly from the wound. Each creature within 5 ft. of it: poisoned until the end of its next turn (DC 13 Con negates).

monster:tob3:ooze-manure.conditionImmunities: blinded, charmed, deafened, exhaustion, frightened, prone

traits.name: Amorphous
traits.description: Move through space 1ft.+ wide with o squeezing.

traits.name: Eye-Watering Stench
traits.description: Gives off an odor so pungent it can bring tears to the eyes. A creature that starts its turn within 20' of the ooze: disadvantage on attack rolls until the start of its next turn (DC 13 Con negates).

traits.name: Flammable
traits.description: If it takes fire damage it bursts into flame until the end of its next turn. When it hits with Pseudopod attack while on fire the Pseudopod deals an extra 3 (1d6) fire.

traits.name: Ooze Nature
traits.description: Doesn’t require sleep.

reactions.name: Split
reactions.description: When a Med or larger manure ooze is subjected to slashing damagesplits into 2 new oozes if it has 10+ hp. Each new ooze has half original's hp rounded down. New oozes are one size smaller than original.

monster:tob3:ooze-scintillating.conditionImmunities: blinded, charmed, deafened, exhaustion, frightened, grappled, prone

traits.name: Amorphous
traits.description: Move through space 1ft.+ wide with o squeezing.

traits.name: Corrosive Form
traits.description: A creature that touches it or hits it with melee attack while within 5 ft. of it takes 10 (3d6) acid.

traits.name: Ooze Nature
traits.description: Doesn’t require sleep.

traits.name: Spider Climb
traits.description: Difficult surfaces even ceilings no ability check.

reactions.name: Shed Oozling
reactions.description: When it has more than 10 hp and is subjected to acid cold lightning or slashing it can lose 10 hp to create an oozling: same stats as scintillating ooze except it is Tiny has 10 hp can't make Weapon Thrashes and can't use this reaction or legendary actions.

legendaryActions.name: Move
legendaryActions.description: Up to its speed with o provoking opportunity attacks.

legendaryActions.name: Grasping Pseudopod
legendaryActions.description: Launches a pseudopod at one creature it can see within 30' of it. Target must make DC 17 Str save or be pulled up to 30' toward the ooze.

legendaryActions.name: Lunging Attack
legendaryActions.description: Makes one Weapon Thrash attack at a creature it can see within 10 ft. of it.

monster:tob3:ooze-shoal.conditionImmunities: blinded, charmed, deafened, exhaustion, frightened, prone

traits.name: False Appearance
traits.description: Until it attacks indistinguishable from a large school of fish.

traits.name: Ooze Nature
traits.description: Doesn’t require sleep.

traits.name: Symbiotically Bound
traits.description: The ooze and fish’s life force have become entwined. Share stats as if one creature and can't be separated.

traits.name: Water Breathing
traits.description: Can breathe only underwater.

monster:tob3:ooze-sinkhole.speed: 20 ft., Burrow 40 ft., Climb 20 ft., Swim 10 ft.
monster:tob3:ooze-sinkhole.conditionImmunities: blinded, charmed, deafened, exhausted, frightened, prone

traits.name: Amorphous
traits.description: Move through space 1ft.+ wide with o squeezing.

traits.name: Hollow Cylindrical Form (Stretched Body Only)
traits.description: Creatures can occupy space in center of cylinder formed by the ooze and each such space is always within ooze’s reach regardless of cylinder's size.

traits.name: Ooze Nature
traits.description: The sinkhole ooze doesn’t require sleep.

traits.name: Seizing Pseudopods
traits.description: Can have up to 6 tendril-like Pseudopods at a time. Each can be attacked (AC 10; 10 hp; immunity to acid poison and psychic). Destroying Pseudopod deals no damage to ooze which can extrude a replacement on its next turn. Pseudopod can also be broken if creature takes an action and makes DC 14 Str check.

traits.name: Slimy Appearance (Stretched Body Only)
traits.description: While it remains motionless is indistinguishable from interior of the pit or hole in the ground it is stretched across though interior walls appear wet.

traits.name: Spider Climb
traits.description: Difficult surfaces even ceilings no ability check.

bonusActions.name: Stretch Body
bonusActions.description: Stretches body around inner walls of a pit sinkhole or other circular opening in the ground. Stretched this way it forms a hollow cylinder up to 25 ft. tall up to 25 ft. radius. Ooze can end stretch as a bonus action occupying nearest unoccupied space to the hole.

reactions.name: Pluck
reactions.description: When 1+ creature falls down center of its cylinder can try to grab up to 2 of them. Each must make DC 14 Dex save or grappled (escape DC 14) in Pseudopod.

monster:tob3:ooze-sinoper.conditionImmunities: blinded, charmed, deafened, exhaustion, frightened, poisoned, prone

traits.name: Amorphous
traits.description: Move through space 1ft.+ wide with o squeezing.

traits.name: False Appearance
traits.description: While motionless indistinguishable from that work of art.

traits.name: Ooze Nature
traits.description: The sinoper ooze doesn’t require sleep.

traits.name: Spider Climb
traits.description: Difficult surfaces even ceilings no ability check.

monster:tob3:ooze-snow.speed: 30 ft., Burrow 20 ft., Climb 15 ft., Swim 15 ft.
monster:tob3:ooze-snow.conditionImmunities: blinded, charmed, deafened, exhaustion, frightened, prone

traits.name: Amorphous
traits.description: Move through space 1ft.+ wide with o squeezing.

traits.name: False Appearance
traits.description: While motionless indistinguishable from patch of snow.

traits.name: Ice Walk
traits.description: Can move across icy surfaces with o ability check. Difficult terrain of ice or snow doesn’t cost it extra move.

traits.name: Ooze Nature
traits.description: Doesn’t require sleep.

traits.name: Snow Blindness
traits.description: When a creature that can see the snow ooze starts its turn within 30' of it that creature is blinded until the start of its next turn (DC 15 Con negates). This doesn’t function while ooze is in dim light or darkness.

traits.name: Snow Burrower
traits.description: Can burrow through nonmagical snow and ice in addition to sand earth and mud.

monster:ccdx:ophanim.speed: 50 ft., Climb 25 ft., Fly 120 ft. (hover), Swim 25 ft.
monster:ccdx:ophanim.damageResistances: radiant; bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing from nonmagical attacks

traits.name: Divine Awareness
traits.description: The ophanim knows if it hears a lie.

traits.name: Innate Spellcasting
traits.description:
The ophanim's innate spellcasting ability is Charisma (spell save DC 21). It can innately cast the following spells, requiring no material components:
At will: bless, detect evil and good, invisibility (self only), scrying, thaumaturgy
3/day each: dispel evil and good, earthquake, holy aura
1/day each: commune, forbiddance, true resurrection

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.description: The ophanim has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The ophanim makes four Light of Judgment attacks.

actions.name: Light of Judgment
actions.description: Ranged Spell Attack: +13 to hit, range 80/320 ft., one target. Hit: 18 (4d8) radiant damage.

actions.name: Holy Fire
actions.description: The ophanim emits a burst of holy fire. Each creature within 30 feet of the ophanim must make a DC 19 Dexterity saving throw, taking 63 (18d6) radiant damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. A humanoid reduced to 0 hp by this damage dies, leaving only a pile of fine ash.

traits.name: Charge
traits.description: If the ophidiotaur moves at least 30 feet straight toward a target and then hits it with a poisoned glaive attack on the same turn, the target takes an extra 5 (1d10) slashing damage.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.description: The ophidiotaur has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The ophidiotaur makes two attacks: one with its bite and one with its glaive.

actions.name: Bite
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 8 (1d6 + 4) piercing damage plus 3 (1d6) poison damage. The target must succeed on a DC 14 Constitution saving throw or be poisoned for 1 minute. The target can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.

actions.name: Poisoned Glaive
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 15 (2d10 + 4) slashing damage plus 3 (1d6) poison damage.

actions.name: Call Serpents
actions.description: The ophidiotaur magically calls 1d6 poisonous snakes or flying snakes (ophidiotaur's choice). The called creatures arrive in 1d4 rounds, acting as allies of the ophidiotaur and obeying its spoken commands. The snakes remain for 1 hour, until the ophidiotaur dies, or until the ophidiotaur dismisses them as a bonus action.

monster:tob2:ophinix.speed: 10 ft., Climb 5 ft., Fly 40 ft., Swim 5 ft.
monster:tob2:ophinix.senses: blindsight 30 ft., darkvision 120 ft., passive Perception 13

traits.name: Conductive Fur
traits.description: While the ophinix is charged with electricity, a creature that touches the ophinix or hits it with a melee attack while within 5 feet of it takes 2 (1d4) lightning damage.

traits.name: Lightning Recharge
traits.description: Whenever the ophinix is subjected to lightning damage, it takes no damage and becomes charged with electricity. If it is already charged, the duration resets to 1 minute.

actions.name: Bite
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 8 (1d8 + 4) piercing damage.

actions.name: Claw
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 7 (1d6 + 4) slashing damage. If the ophinix is charged with electricity, the target also takes 5 (2d4) lightning damage.

actions.name: Generate Static
actions.description: The ophinix rubs along a dry surface and charges its fur with static electricity. Its fur remains charged with electricity for 1 minute or until it uses Lightning Strike.

actions.name: Lightning Strike
actions.description: The ophinix releases its static electricity at up to three targets it can see within 30 feet of it. Each creature must make a DC 12 Dexterity saving throw, taking 5 (2d4) lightning damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. After using Lightning Strike, the ophinix is no longer charged with electricity. It can't use Lightning Strike if isn't charged with electricity.

monster:tob2:ophio-fungus.conditionImmunities: blinded, charmed, deafened, frightened, poisoned, prone

traits.name: Hypnotic Secretion
traits.description: When a creature starts its turn within 30 feet of the fungus, it must make a DC 15 Charisma saving throw. On a failure, the creature is charmed for 1 hour and regards the fungus as a friendly acquaintance. If the fungus or one of its allies harms the charmed creature, this effect ends. If a creature stays charmed for the full hour, it becomes infected with ophio spores. If the creature’s saving throw is successful or the effect ends for it, the creature is immune to the ophio fungus’ Hypnotic Secretion for the next 24 hours. A creature that doesn’t need to breathe is immune to the fungus’ Hypnotic Secretion. A creature that does need to breathe can still be affected, even if it holds its breath.

actions.name: Release Spores
actions.description: The ophio fungus focuses its spores on up to three creatures it can see within 30 feet of it. Each creature must make a DC 15 Constitution saving throw. On a failure, a creature takes 14 (4d6) poison damage and, if it is a humanoid, it becomes infected with ophio spores. On a success, a creature takes half the damage and isn't infected with spores. A creature that doesn't need to breathe automatically succeeds on this saving throw. A creature that does need to breathe can still be affected, even if it holds its breath.

traits.name: Stalwart
traits.description: If the orc starts its turn afflicted by an ongoing effect that allows for a repeated save to end the effect, such as the hold spell or the poison from an ettercap's Bite, the orc can make the save at the start of the turn instead of the end and has advantage on the save.

actions.name: Greataxe
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 9 (1d12+3) slashing damage.

actions.name: Javelin
actions.description: Melee or Ranged Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 30/120 ft., one target. Hit: 6 (1d6+3) piercing damage.

bonusActions.name: Warrior's Advance
bonusActions.description: The orc moves up to its speed toward a hostile creature that it can see.

traits.name: Martial Adept
traits.description: A melee or ranged weapon deals one extra die of its damage when the orc warlord hits with it (included in the attack).

traits.name: Stalwart
traits.description: As the orc.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The orc warlord makes two Longsword attacks and one Skull Club attack, or it makes three Longbow attacks.

actions.name: Longsword
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 13 (2d8+4) slashing damage.

actions.name: Skull Club
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 9 (2d4+4) piercing damage.

actions.name: Longbow
actions.description: Ranged Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, range 150/600 ft., one target. Hit: 11 (2d8+2) piercing damage.

bonusActions.name: Warrior's Advance
bonusActions.description: As the orc.

bonusActions.name: Warlord's Rally
bonusActions.description: The warlord yells a rallying cry to its allies. Each friendly creature within 30 feet of the warlord that can hear the warlord has advantage on the next attack roll it makes before the start of the warlord's next turn.

traits.name: Echolocation
traits.description: The orca can't use its keensense while deafened.

traits.name: Heightened Hearing
traits.description: The orca's Perception is 18 when perceiving by hearing.

traits.name: Hold Breath
traits.description: The orca can hold its breath for 30 minutes.
